raw.description:
About Us:

Beamdog, a leading video game studio based in Edmonton, Alberta, has been creating captivating gaming experiences since 2009. Led by industry veteran Trent Oster, the studio has become renowned for developing enhanced editions of classic games and original content across multiple platforms, including Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, PC, and mobile devices. Best known for reviving iconic Dungeons & Dragons RPGs like Baldur’s Gate and Planescape: Torment, Beamdog is dedicated to delivering unforgettable experiences for gamers worldwide.

Position Summary:

As a Senior Writer, you will create engaging characters, dialogue, and stories that bring our games to life. Working closely with creative leadership and other disciplines, you will contribute ideas and narrative expertise while building on the project’s established voice, themes, and creative direction. This hands-on role combines original writing, editing, and narrative implementation, with a focus on delivering compelling, high-quality content that supports gameplay and meets production needs.

This position offers remote work within Canada, hybrid, or onsite work arrangements, with a strong preference for candidates based in Edmonton, Alberta, who can spend time working from our office.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the Design Director and/or project leadership to develop and maintain narrative themes, tone, and style that support the game’s creative vision and intended player experience.
  • Write compelling characters, dialogue, quests, and storylines, developing character biographies, motivations, relationships, and arcs that remain consistent across narrative content and gameplay.
  • Write and revise combat barks, quest banter, lore, and other in-game text, adapting voice and style to the needs of the project.
  • Produce high-quality narrative content that meets agreed production targets and maintains the project’s established voice, tone, and brand, communicating progress and dependencies to support timely delivery.
  • Translate narrative concepts, outlines, and creative briefs into production-ready content, incorporating feedback from creative leadership and relevant partners throughout drafting and revision.
  • Work closely with designers, artists, and other disciplines to integrate storytelling with gameplay, worldbuilding, and visual presentation.
  • Review and edit narrative content for clarity, pacing, continuity, character voice, and consistency with established lore and style guidelines.
  • Implement and refine narrative content using project tools and game engines, working with other disciplines to address technical constraints and issues identified through playtesting.
  • Contribute to narrative documentation, including style guides and story outlines.
  • Provide constructive peer feedback and mentor less experienced writers and narrative designers, sharing expertise to strengthen the quality and consistency of the project’s narrative content.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Significant professional writing experience in the game or entertainment industry, including writing contributions to at least one shipped game.
  • Strong understanding of interactive storytelling and game-design fundamentals, including experience developing branching dialogue or nonlinear narratives.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, engaging stories and distinctive characters with consistent voices, motivations, and emotional depth.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand an established brand and creative direction, sustaining its themes, tone, style, and character voices.
  • A demonstrated record of sustained, high-quality writing output, with the ability to work independently, prioritize assignments, and meet the volume, pace, and revision demands of game production.
  • Strong editing skills, with experience revising creative content for clarity, structure, pacing, and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret and incorporate creative feedback, including making substantive revisions to meet project needs.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across disciplines and presenting narrative ideas clearly.
  • Strong research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt narrative ideas to technical, production, and resource constraints.
  • Experience implementing narrative content in game engines such as Unreal or Unity, or comparable narrative development tools.

Bonus Points:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in English, Creative Writing, Theatre, Film, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Perforce, and other production or version-control tools.
  • Experience developing narrative style guides, maintaining continuity across substantial bodies of content, and providing peer mentorship.
  • Strong preference to those based in Edmonton, Alberta.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
  • Three weeks of paid vacation, generous paid sick leave, additional paid personal days, and a paid studio closure over the holiday season.
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits, including enhanced mental health support.
  • RRSP matching to support your long-term financial goals.
  • Flexible work arrangements, with remote, hybrid, and in-office options.
  • A collaborative environment where you can share ideas, strengthen your craft, and help shape the player experience.

An up to date portfolio/writing samples must be included with your application. There may also be an assessment portion associated with the recruitment process for this role. Thank you to all applicants for your interest in Beamdog. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Beamdog is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Salary: 80-100K

raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Director of Access Strategy & Marketing will lead the development and execution of access strategies, non-clinical positioning, and marketing materials for the RevMed portfolio with a focus on pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) or non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). This role will focus on developing the short to medium term non-clinical value proposition across payers, HCPs, organized customers (GPOs, IDNs, etc.) and channel partners. This role will be instrumental in supporting a successful launch through strategy and tactical planning, tailoring messages to various customer types, and working cross-functionally with Brand Marketing, National Account, Medical/HEOR, Regulatory and Compliance partners. The ideal candidate will have exceptional strategy, influence, and collaboration competencies, oncology launch experience, and experience translating a dynamic landscape into access strategy.

This position is open to remote candidates, though preference will be given to candidates that can be based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Lead the development and execution of access marketing strategies to align with cross-functional priorities and portfolio objectives.

  • Set the direction and develop value proposition messaging and materials tailored to payers, PBMs, IDNs, GPOs, channel partners, and other decisionmakers.

  • Influence clinical, economic, and real-world evidence plans and translate into compelling messages that communicate the portfolio’s value and address stakeholder evidence needs.

  • Develop and execute a customer insights plan and partner with national accounts and field leadership to translate customer insights into strategy and materials.

  • Direct compliant marketing tactics for GPOs and organized providers across relevant channels.

  • Lead pull-through and training for materials and market access initiatives.

  • Lead Market Access launch readiness, align access teams around shared priorities, and represent Market Access in cross-functional forums.

  • Guide educational initiatives that strengthen internal and external understanding of RevMed’s market access programs.

  • Oversee day-to-day agency projects, timelines, deliverables, and assigned budgets.

  • Partner with Brand Marketing, Regulatory, and Compliance to ensure materials advance brand goals and meet compliance requirements.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required with 10+ years of experience in Marketing, Product Planning, and/or Managed Care.

  • Experience in new product launches, including strategy development and tactical execution.

  • Strong understanding of the access landscape across all market access stakeholders.

  • Prior experience with developing co-positioning strategies across multiple assets and identifying portfolio tradeoffs.

  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and effectively deliver results within established timelines.

  • Ability to represent Revolution Medicines well: strong interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication.

  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Preferred Skills:

  • 12+ years of experience in Marketing and/or Managed Care.

  • Oral oncolytic product experience strongly.

  • Understanding of distribution models, patient support programs, US public policy, and reimbursement dynamics.

  • Prior experience working with Compliance and Regulatory teams.

  • Prior experience in customer-facing roles.

raw.title: UHNW Marketing Strategist
raw.excerpt: About Wealth Enhancement Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients.
raw.description:
About Wealth Enhancement


Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We continually seek to perfect our craft of personalized financial planning with our team-based Roundtable and UniFi processes that go far beyond the standard approach. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices - and growing - nationwide.


Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit .


We're hiring an UHNW (ultra-high net worth) Marketing Strategist to play a foundational role in building and advancing Wealth Enhancement's UHNW and Private Wealth Advisor Marketing capability while serving as a strategic marketing partner to UHNW advisor teams.


This role combines program development, strategic consulting, market expertise, advisor relationship management and cross-functional leadership. The Strategist will help define the marketing capabilities, programs and experiences required to support the evolving UHNW business while translating individual advisor growth ambitions into differentiated, actionable marketing strategies.


As a trusted partner, the Strategist will bring a strong marketing point of view, deep understanding of affluent audiences and sound business judgment. The role will connect advisor and client needs with enterprise capabilities, influence priorities across teams, and help move opportunities from strategy through implementation, measurement and scale. This role requires a proactive, action-oriented builder who is comfortable creating clarity in ambiguous situations, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and moving ideas quickly from concept to testing, learning, and implementation.


This is a fully remote. Please note that this position will primarily serve offices based in the Eastern Time Zone. While you do not need to be located on the East Coast, you must be available during regular EST/EDT business hours. Additionally, periodic travel is required based on advisor, business, and departmental needs. Travel may include advisor-team meetings, strategic planning sessions, client or prospect events, department meetings, and firm-sponsored gatherings. Roughly 4-6x per year for 2-3 days at a time.


In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $95,000.00 to $110,000.00, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. The role is also eligible to participate in the corporate bonus plan. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.


Primary Job Functions


UHNW Marketing Strategy, Development & Implementation

  • Help define and build Wealth Enhancement's UHNW Advisor Marketing strategy, operating model, capabilities and roadmap
  • Translate advisor, client and business needs into prioritized marketing initiatives, programs and solutions
  • Take ownership of developing, launching, testing, and refining new UHNW marketing programs, moving from concept to pilot with appropriate speed and limited oversight, then applying learnings to improve adoption and scale
  • Partner across Content, Creative, Digital, Web, Events, Analytics, Experience, Product and Advisor Marketing to move strategic priorities from opportunity to implementation
  • Balance the high-touch and customized needs of UHNW teams with the development of repeatable, scalable marketing capabilities
  • Define and differentiate UHNW and Private Wealth target audiences, value propositions, service experiences and supporting marketing capabilities
  • Identify and evaluate tools, technologies, partners and emerging approaches that could strengthen advisor growth, marketing effectiveness or the UHNW client experience
  • Establish scalable frameworks, best practices and planning tools and identify successful approaches that can be replicated across UHNW and Private Wealth teams

Advisor Partnership & Strategic Consulting

  • Serve as the primary strategic marketing partner for a portfolio of UHNW and Private Wealth advisor teams
  • Build a deep understanding of advisor business objectives, client demographics, target markets, relationships, referral networks, growth ambitions and barriers to growth
  • Lead strategic conversations that translate business objectives and market opportunities into focused marketing priorities and actionable plans
  • Build trusted relationships with advisors and business leaders by bringing expertise, perspective, thoughtful recommendations and a clear marketing point of view
  • Influence advisor commitment and maintain momentum by establishing priorities, monitoring progress and addressing barriers to execution
  • Proactively identify opportunities, recommend a path forward, and initiate appropriate next steps without relying on advisors or leaders to define every action
  • Partner with Advisor Marketing Specialists and cross-functional partners on execution while maintaining ownership of strategic direction, advisor communication, priorities and accountability

UHNW Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and manage strategic marketing plans and budgets aligned with advisor business objectives, target audiences and growth opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships, strengthen market visibility, expand referral and center-of-influence networks, and attract ideal prospective clients
  • Translate strategic priorities into defined initiatives, advisor commitments, timelines, budgets, ownership and measurable outcomes
  • Recommend the appropriate mix of programs, campaigns, content, thought leadership, events, digital experiences and firm resources to advance advisor objectives
  • Continuously evaluate business conditions, advisor priorities and performance indicators and adapt recommendations accordingly

UHNW Market, Client & Competitive Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on UHNW audiences, affluent client engagement, relationship-based growth and advisor positioning
  • Monitor evolving UHNW client expectations, market trends, competitive activity and emerging growth opportunities and translate insights into practical recommendations
  • Advise teams on thought leadership, community presence, centers of influence, partnerships, client experiences and other strategies designed to strengthen credibility, relationships and influence with affluent audiences
  • Bring the voice of advisors and UHNW clients into the development and evolution of Wealth Enhancement's marketing programs, resources and capabilities
  • Connect enterprise resources and expertise with local market opportunities in ways that are relevant and actionable for advisor teams

Performance, Measurement & Optimization

  • Use Salesforce, firm dashboards, advisor insights and approved reporting tools to evaluate marketing performance and business outcomes
  • Analyze measures including net flows, client acquisition, referrals, advisor activity, audience engagement, event outcomes, marketing adoption and budget utilization
  • Translate data and business context into actionable recommendations and identify opportunities requiring adjustment, additional investment or a different approach
  • Establish measurement approaches that demonstrate the adoption, effectiveness and business impact of UHNW marketing initiatives
  • Identify successful advisor practices and marketing strategies that can be documented, refined and scaled across UHNW and Private Wealth teams

Improve Service Quality by Using AI and Digital Tools

  • Use approved AI and digital tools to simplify work, improve service quality, and increase efficiency, while validating outputs for accuracy, privacy, and business alignment
  • Identify and escalate inaccurate information and knowledge gaps, or issues related to digital tools

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means both building a stronger UHNW Advisor Marketing capability and delivering meaningful value to individual advisor teams.

  • A clearly defined UHNW Advisor Marketing strategy, roadmap and set of priorities are established and continue to evolve with the business
  • New UHNW marketing programs and capabilities are successfully developed, tested, refined and scaled
  • Advisor teams view the Strategist as a trusted business and marketing partner who brings expertise, perspective and direction
  • UHNW advisor teams have focused marketing strategies aligned with their business goals, target audiences and market opportunities
  • Advisors effectively leverage Wealth Enhancement's capabilities and make intentional marketing investments aligned with their highest-priority opportunities
  • Advisor and client insights consistently inform the development of programs, resources and experiences
  • Successful practices are identified and translated into repeatable approaches that benefit the broader UHNW business
  • Cross-functional partners have clarity around UHNW marketing priorities, advisor needs and their role in supporting the business
  • Marketing efforts demonstrate measurable progress toward advisor growth, client acquisition, referrals, engagement and relationship-building objectives
  • The Strategist demonstrates sound judgment under ambiguity, makes timely recommendations, and adjusts course as new information becomes available
  • Leaders, advisors, and partners experience the Strategist as a proactive owner who anticipates needs, removes barriers, and consistently drives work forward

Education/Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience in marketing strategy, advisor consulting, business development, field marketing, wealth management, client success, practice management, or a related client-facing role
  • Demonstrated ability to develop strategic marketing recommendations and translate them into actionable plans, programs, or growth initiatives
  • Experience supporting high-performing professionals, business owners, advisors, executives, or client-facing teams
  • Strong understanding of relationship-based growth strategies, community engagement, referral development, and advisor positioning
  • Ability to build trust, influence decisions, and gain commitment without direct authority
  • Ability to facilitate strategic discussions and confidently challenge conventional thinking when appropriate
  • Experience developing and managing stakeholder relationships across multiple business functions
  • Strong business acumen and ability to connect marketing recommendations to business outcomes
  • Comfort interpreting data, dashboards, CRM insights, and performance trends to inform recommendations
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong advisor and stakeholder relationships
  • Proficiency with CRM, reporting, project-management, and Microsoft 365 tools
  • Proven ability to create structure, establish priorities, and move work forward in an evolving or ambiguous environment
  • Demonstrated bias for action and ability to make sound, timely decisions with incomplete information
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field preferred (or equivalent as demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education)
  • Experience within wealth management, private wealth, financial services, family office, banking, or a related industry
  • Experience supporting affluent or UHNW client segments
  • Understanding of centers of influence, business-owner marketing, executive audiences, multigenerational wealth conversations, and relationship-based growth strategies
  • Experience working with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms
  • Experience leading marketing pilots, strategic initiatives, or cross-functional projects
  • Experience utilizing data, technology, and AI-enabled tools to support marketing effectiveness and advisor growth
  • Demonstrated experience building or launching a new program or business initiative all the way through to go-to-market within an evolving organization

Owns product strategy from opportunity identification and market analysis through definition, build, launch, and continuous iteration.

Develops a deep understanding of marketplace requirements, customer needs, and competitive dynamics in automotive supply chain to apply to continuous product improvements. Owns the end-to-end product lifecycle — from opportunity identification and requirements definition through design, development, launch, and post-launch iteration. Identifies, prioritizes, and builds the business case for high-impact opportunities to apply AI-driven automation, decisioning, and data-driven insights across both customer-facing products and internal operating processes. Partners closely with Engineering and Data Science to translate business problems into clear, well-scoped product requirements, evaluating feasibility, trade-offs, and technical approach. Defines success metrics and experiment designs (e.g., A/B tests, pilots) to validate product hypotheses and quantify impact on productivity, revenue, and customer experience. Partners with OEM field teams and internal Success teams to develop strategic post-launch campaigns that maximize dealer adoption and program ROI. Partners with Sales, Marketing, and Product leadership to align go-to-market strategy, positioning, and pricing for new Supply Chain product capabilities. Develops and delivers product and program performance reporting and insights to OEM customers and OEC leadership, ensuring outcomes are clearly tied back to business impact. Act as an escalation point for product-related issues, driving timely resolution and communicating outcomes to internal and external stakeholders. Serves as a subject-matter expert on applying AI within automotive supply chain, educating stakeholders and leadership on opportunities, risks, and responsible-AI considerations where relevant. Monitors adoption and performance of the product and features, iterating the roadmap based on usage data, customer feedback, and business results. Helps to guide the strategy and roadmap for supply chain forecasting and demand planning capabilities, ensuring models and tools reflect sound forecasting methodology and deliver actionable accuracy for customers.

Education

In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

Experience

At least 6 years of product management experience with a background that includes full product lifecycle ownership (market/opportunity analysis, requirements definition, development partnership, launch, and iteration), at least 3 years leading AI/ML-powered or data-driven product initiatives from concept through launch, prior experience defining and tracking product KPIs and designing experiments (e.g., A/B testing, pilots) to validate product hypotheses, plus a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional AI or data-driven product initiatives from concept through steady-state performance.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

Working knowledge of the AI/ML product development lifecycle, data pipelines, model evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, and responsible AI practices. Deep automotive industry domain expertise, including familiarity with OEM programs, dealer operations, and automotive supply chain workflows. Working knowledge of supply chain forecasting and demand planning methodologies (e.g., statistical forecasting, inventory optimization, forecast accuracy measurement) and how they translate into product requirements. Skilled at identifying high-impact AI use cases that balance technical feasibility, customer desirability, and business value. Ability to build and maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and internal senior stakeholders, comfortable owning those conversations directly. Excellent strategic thinking and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems and data into clear product requirements and actionable recommendations. Ability to take initiative and ownership, and drive team and cross-functional efficiency to deliver against aggressive timelines. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote work environment while maintaining quality and customer focus. Excellent communication skills and can present product strategy and performance clearly to both customer leadership and internal executive teams.

Willing and able to attend virtual meetings with the laptop camera on.

Job Description

Position Overview

Momentive Software is hiring an Account Development Representative to drive top-of-funnel cross-sell pipeline from our existing client base to our SMB sales team.

Position Summary

Momentive Software is hiring an Account Development Representative to help drive top-of-funnel cross-sell pipeline from the existing Momentive client base to our SMB sellers. We need a self-directed, motivated individual who can identify expansion opportunities, activate relevant client signals, and create qualified cross-sell meetings that progress into meaningful pipeline and closed/won business.

This individual will partner closely with Business Development, SMB Sales, Client Success, Marketing, and Go-To-Market teams to prioritize high-propensity accounts, execute targeted outreach, and ensure a coordinated client experience. The role is an individual contributor position focused on creating qualified expansion opportunities, maintaining strong pipeline hygiene, and delivering clear handoffs to the appropriate sales owner.

A Day in the Life

  • Drive proactive cross-sell prospecting into the existing Momentive client base, with emphasis on SMB accounts and high-propensity white-space opportunities.
  • Research client accounts to understand current Momentive products, potential product gaps, organizational priorities, buying centers, and relevant triggers for expansion conversations.
  • Use account signals, intent data, relationship context, and internal guidance to prioritize outreach and determine the most relevant cross-sell motion.
  • Create personalized multi-channel outreach that connects Momentive product value to the client's current operating environment and likely business priorities.
  • Book and progress qualified cross-sell meetings for SMB sellers, ensuring meetings are well-prepared, well-documented, and connected to a clear business opportunity.

 

We are looking for someone who brings

Experience:

raw.excerpt: THE COMPANY Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions.
raw.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking an exceptional Chief Technology Officer (High-Speed Analog) to lead the technical vision of Analogue Insight as we grow from a fast-moving start-up into a scale-up. As CTO, you will own the technology strategy for our electrical and photonic interconnect portfolio – 112G/224G-class SerDes, 32G/64G UCIe die-to-die PHYs, high-bandwidth memory interfaces, data converters (ADC/DAC) and optical I/O – and drive it across our customer programmes and product roadmap. You will lead the CTO Office, act as the company's senior technical voice with customers, partners, foundries and investors, and build deep links between Analogue Insight and leading universities and research institutes.
This role is ideal for a recognised leader in high-speed analog and mixed-signal design, with strong academic standing and strong ties to industry. We particularly welcome candidates with a professorship or senior research background who want to see their work reach customer silicon.
Location: Fully remote, ideally based in the UK, Europe, Armenia, India, Canada or the US.
Reporting to: CEO, as a member of the executive team.
Hiring Manager: Christian Borelli, Founder, CEO & CPO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Technology Vision & Strategy: Define and own Analogue Insight's long-term technology vision for electrical and photonic interconnect, grounded in first-principles engineering and aligned with market needs, customer roadmaps and the company's growth plans.
  • IP & Product Roadmap: Translate the strategy into a clear multi-year IP roadmap – next-generation SerDes, UCIe die-to-die links, high-bandwidth memory interfaces, data converters and optical I/O – prioritising investment, tape-outs and advanced-node choices, and owning technical risk mitigation, with the CEO and executive team.
  • Architecture & Technical Authority: Act as the final technical authority on architecture, circuit approaches and design methodology, setting aggressive performance, power, area and robustness targets, and leading technical reviews across architecture, analog/mixed-signal, digital, layout and validation.
  • Hardest Technical Problems: Personally drive resolution of the most challenging circuit and system issues through first-principles analysis, modelling, simulation and silicon-based investigation.
  • Design Closure & Silicon Success: Ensure robust design closure – post-layout verification, performance optimisation and silicon-to-model correlation – so that our IP is first-time-right in customer silicon.
  • CTO Office & Technical Leadership: Build and lead the CTO Office and the technical leadership team, mentoring senior and principal engineers, raising the technical bar and shaping our technical career track.
  • Research & Innovation: Lead advanced R&D and technology exploration, driving architectural innovation in high-speed analog, mixed-signal and photonic circuits, and growing a strong patent and publication portfolio.
  • Academic & Research Partnerships: Leverage your network to build and lead partnerships with top universities and research institutes, including joint research programmes, funded projects, PhD and post-doc collaborations, and talent pipelines.
  • Customer & Industry Engagement: Serve as the senior technical voice of the company with customers, foundries, EDA vendors, standards bodies and ecosystem partners, supporting key wins and strategic engagements.
  • Investor & Board Support: Represent the technology vision to investors, advisors and the board, and support technical due diligence for fundraising, grants and potential acquisitions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Promote rigorous engineering practices, design quality and knowledge sharing, and champion design automation, simulation automation and AI-assisted design to scale productivity and quality.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with a focus on high-speed analog/mixed-signal circuit design
  • 15+ years of combined industry and/or academic experience in high-speed analog design, including senior technical leadership roles
  • World-class expertise in at least one of: high-speed wireline transceivers (SerDes, die-to-die links), clocking and PLLs, or high-speed data converters – with a strong system-level view across the full link
  • Strong understanding of advanced CMOS (FinFET and beyond), packaging and chiplet integration, and the interaction between circuits, channels and systems
  • Proven track record of taking complex designs from architecture to successful silicon
  • Strong academic and industry standing, evidenced by publications at leading venues (e.g. ISSCC, VLSI, JSSC, CICC), patents and invited talks
  • An established network across leading universities, research institutes and the semiconductor industry
  • Experience building and leading high-performing technical teams, ideally including distributed or remote teams
Nice-to-have:
  • Current or past professorship or senior research position at a leading university
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in one or more of the following circuit areas:
    • Fractional-N PLLs, LC-VCOs, DTC/TDC, multi-modulus dividers
    • Phase interpolators, injection-locked oscillators, multi-phase clock generation
    • High-speed time-interleaved DACs and line drivers
    • TIAs, CTLEs, PGAs and other high-bandwidth amplifiers
    • Time-interleaved SAR ADCs and track-and-hold circuits
    • Bandgaps, LDOs, temperature sensors and other precision/support circuits
  • Experience in photonic or optical interconnect (e.g. TIAs, drivers, co-packaged optics)
  • Experience with circuit modelling, simulation automation, optimisation and silicon-to-model correlation
  • Involvement in standards bodies or consortia (e.g. UCIe, JEDEC, OIF, IEEE)
  • Experience securing and leading funded research programmes and industry–academia collaborations
  • Start-up or scale-up experience, including working with investors and boards

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Inspiring, clear communication in professional English – able to engage engineers, customers, academics and investors alike
  • Strategic thinker who is also comfortable going deep into technical details
  • Collaborative, feedback-oriented leadership style that builds trust across a remote team
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow senior engineers and future technical leaders
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information
  • We are looking for a technical leader who combines deep circuit-design expertise with architectural thinking, research vision and hands-on execution to solve the hardest problems in next-generation high-speed connectivity – and who can build a team that does the same.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 25 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star:We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely:We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact:Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn’t disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work:We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we’ll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real analog IP used in customer silicon
  • Supportive team culture – a dedicated manager and a team of colleagues ready to help
  • Competitive, transparent compensation– adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview(90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. Senior Management Discussion (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics with our Senior Management Team
  5. HR & Culture Call (45 min)–values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  6. Offer & Next Steps– we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.
Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

raw.title: Chief Technology Officer (High-Speed Analog)
raw.excerpt: THE COMPANY Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions.
raw.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking an exceptional Chief Technology Officer (High-Speed Analog) to lead the technical vision of Analogue Insight as we grow from a fast-moving start-up into a scale-up. As CTO, you will own the technology strategy for our electrical and photonic interconnect portfolio – 112G/224G-class SerDes, 32G/64G UCIe die-to-die PHYs, high-bandwidth memory interfaces, data converters (ADC/DAC) and optical I/O – and drive it across our customer programmes and product roadmap. You will lead the CTO Office, act as the company's senior technical voice with customers, partners, foundries and investors, and build deep links between Analogue Insight and leading universities and research institutes.
This role is ideal for a recognised leader in high-speed analog and mixed-signal design, with strong academic standing and strong ties to industry. We particularly welcome candidates with a professorship or senior research background who want to see their work reach customer silicon.
Location: Fully remote, ideally based in the UK, Europe, Armenia, India, Canada or the US.
Reporting to: CEO, as a member of the executive team.
Hiring Manager: Christian Borelli, Founder, CEO & CPO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Technology Vision & Strategy: Define and own Analogue Insight's long-term technology vision for electrical and photonic interconnect, grounded in first-principles engineering and aligned with market needs, customer roadmaps and the company's growth plans.
  • IP & Product Roadmap: Translate the strategy into a clear multi-year IP roadmap – next-generation SerDes, UCIe die-to-die links, high-bandwidth memory interfaces, data converters and optical I/O – prioritising investment, tape-outs and advanced-node choices, and owning technical risk mitigation, with the CEO and executive team.
  • Architecture & Technical Authority: Act as the final technical authority on architecture, circuit approaches and design methodology, setting aggressive performance, power, area and robustness targets, and leading technical reviews across architecture, analog/mixed-signal, digital, layout and validation.
  • Hardest Technical Problems: Personally drive resolution of the most challenging circuit and system issues through first-principles analysis, modelling, simulation and silicon-based investigation.
  • Design Closure & Silicon Success: Ensure robust design closure – post-layout verification, performance optimisation and silicon-to-model correlation – so that our IP is first-time-right in customer silicon.
  • CTO Office & Technical Leadership: Build and lead the CTO Office and the technical leadership team, mentoring senior and principal engineers, raising the technical bar and shaping our technical career track.
  • Research & Innovation: Lead advanced R&D and technology exploration, driving architectural innovation in high-speed analog, mixed-signal and photonic circuits, and growing a strong patent and publication portfolio.
  • Academic & Research Partnerships: Leverage your network to build and lead partnerships with top universities and research institutes, including joint research programmes, funded projects, PhD and post-doc collaborations, and talent pipelines.
  • Customer & Industry Engagement: Serve as the senior technical voice of the company with customers, foundries, EDA vendors, standards bodies and ecosystem partners, supporting key wins and strategic engagements.
  • Investor & Board Support: Represent the technology vision to investors, advisors and the board, and support technical due diligence for fundraising, grants and potential acquisitions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Promote rigorous engineering practices, design quality and knowledge sharing, and champion design automation, simulation automation and AI-assisted design to scale productivity and quality.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with a focus on high-speed analog/mixed-signal circuit design
  • 15+ years of combined industry and/or academic experience in high-speed analog design, including senior technical leadership roles
  • World-class expertise in at least one of: high-speed wireline transceivers (SerDes, die-to-die links), clocking and PLLs, or high-speed data converters – with a strong system-level view across the full link
  • Strong understanding of advanced CMOS (FinFET and beyond), packaging and chiplet integration, and the interaction between circuits, channels and systems
  • Proven track record of taking complex designs from architecture to successful silicon
  • Strong academic and industry standing, evidenced by publications at leading venues (e.g. ISSCC, VLSI, JSSC, CICC), patents and invited talks
  • An established network across leading universities, research institutes and the semiconductor industry
  • Experience building and leading high-performing technical teams, ideally including distributed or remote teams
Nice-to-have:
  • Current or past professorship or senior research position at a leading university
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in one or more of the following circuit areas:
    • Fractional-N PLLs, LC-VCOs, DTC/TDC, multi-modulus dividers
    • Phase interpolators, injection-locked oscillators, multi-phase clock generation
    • High-speed time-interleaved DACs and line drivers
    • TIAs, CTLEs, PGAs and other high-bandwidth amplifiers
    • Time-interleaved SAR ADCs and track-and-hold circuits
    • Bandgaps, LDOs, temperature sensors and other precision/support circuits
  • Experience in photonic or optical interconnect (e.g. TIAs, drivers, co-packaged optics)
  • Experience with circuit modelling, simulation automation, optimisation and silicon-to-model correlation
  • Involvement in standards bodies or consortia (e.g. UCIe, JEDEC, OIF, IEEE)
  • Experience securing and leading funded research programmes and industry–academia collaborations
  • Start-up or scale-up experience, including working with investors and boards

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Inspiring, clear communication in professional English – able to engage engineers, customers, academics and investors alike
  • Strategic thinker who is also comfortable going deep into technical details
  • Collaborative, feedback-oriented leadership style that builds trust across a remote team
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow senior engineers and future technical leaders
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information
  • We are looking for a technical leader who combines deep circuit-design expertise with architectural thinking, research vision and hands-on execution to solve the hardest problems in next-generation high-speed connectivity – and who can build a team that does the same.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 25 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star:We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely:We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact:Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn’t disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work:We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we’ll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real analog IP used in customer silicon
  • Supportive team culture – a dedicated manager and a team of colleagues ready to help
  • Competitive, transparent compensation– adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview(90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. Senior Management Discussion (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics with our Senior Management Team
  5. HR & Culture Call (45 min)–values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  6. Offer & Next Steps– we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.
Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Sr. Sales Engineer for, you will be the go-to product and technical expert for Alpaca's enterprise partners across. You will bridge technical and business conversations: a customer-facing engineer with strong API knowledge, experience supporting enterprise customers, and collaborating effectively with our global team. You will support enterprise partners and expand our base of enterprise partners, acting as the technical bridge between local partners, vendors, and regulators and Alpaca's global engineering team.

What you will do:

  • Provide technical support and relationship management for existing enterprise customers, acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the partner lifecycle.
  • Partner with the Sales and Solutions teams on pre-sales technical discussions, solution design, and API consultations, and present compelling product and technical use cases to prospective clients.
  • Guide new enterprise customers through API integration, implementation, and onboarding.
  • Act as the voice of customers by collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve localized experiences; translate complex business and technical requirements into clear specifications for Alpaca's global engineering team.

  • Own technical sales engagement end-to-end: discovery calls, solution validation, RFPs, and security questionnaires that win deals; lead demo strategy and execution.

  • Coordinate with local regulators, vendors, and partners, and relay those requirements to global product and engineering.
  • Help customers successfully adopt Alpaca's platform while maintaining a high standard of technical and customer support; travel as needed.
  • Stay updated on internal product development timelines and work closely with the product team to test and roll out new features to partners.

What we look for (Must-Haves):

  • Experience supporting enterprise / B2B customers in a technical, sales engineering, or solutions engineering role (typically 5+ years), ideally at API or SaaS-first companies.

  • Familiarity with Metabase.
  • Experience working with the FIX protocol.
  • Experience working with OpenAPI, ReadMe, and documentation.
  • Excited to learn more about the securities industry.
  • Spanish or Portuguese

Job Description Summary:

The Director, Franchise Leadership – North Zone serves as the primary strategic business partner between The Coca-Cola Company and Coca-Cola Southwest Beverages (CCSWB) across the North Zone.

The role is responsible for strengthening system alignment, accelerating profitable growth, and driving marketplace excellence across the total Coca-Cola beverage portfolio, including Trademark Coca-Cola, Sparkling Flavors, Water, Sports, Juice, Dairy, Tea, Coffee, Energy, and Emerging Categories. Reporting to the Senior Director II, Franchise Operations, the role translates aligned North Zone and commercial priorities into bottler-specific operating plans and works across multiple stakeholders to deliver volume, revenue, transactions, share, and profitable growth objectives. The role connects commercial with frontline execution, maintains a regular in-market cadence across assigned geographies, and leads follow-through on agreed corrective actions. The Director also identifies common execution and capability gaps, shares successful practices across bottlers, and builds capabilities in partnership with the appropriate North Zone functional teams. The Director operates as an experienced individual contributor and escalates material risks, resource needs, and trade-offs with clear recommendations.


The successful candidate demonstrates a strong Growth Mindset, continuously identifying opportunities to accelerate business performance, challenge conventional thinking, leverage insights, build organizational capabilities, and inspire both Company and bottler partners to pursue innovative solutions that create sustainable value for the Coca-Cola system.


What You’ll Do for Us


  • Serve as the primary strategic liaison between The Coca-Cola Company and Coca-Cola Southwest Beverages (CCSWB) North Zone leadership team.
  • Drive performance across the full Coca-Cola portfolio within CCSWB North Zone, with responsibility spanning all categories, brands, and packages in the assigned geography, supporting profitable volume, revenue, transactions, mix, and share growth through clear territory priorities and accountable execution with bottler partner.
  • Lead territory deployment of aligned commercial strategies and initiatives, partnering with Commercial and other functional teams to establish operational readiness, clear sequencing, ownership, and adoption within the assigned geography.
  • Champion execution excellence by coaching, influencing, and supporting the bottler organization to achieve top-tier performance in Market Street Challenge and other system execution benchmarks. Ensure the right utilization and deployment of Market Street Challenge and Execute, Sell Hunt capabilities.
  • Build and maintain strong executive-level relationships that foster trust, transparency, and mutual accountability.
  • Partner with CCSWB and internal stakeholders to provide strategic input, recommendations, and fact-based insights during the development of annual and long-range Joint Business Plans (JBPs).
  • Develop and activate contingency plans with bottler and cross-functional partners to protect annual business plan delivery across revenue, volume, share, net outlets, SOVI, and pricing execution; monitor recovery milestones and results.
  • Expand territory potential through Share of Visual Inventory (SOVI), Cold Drink Equipment (CDE), innovation execution, and strong conversion of aligned category and commercial plans into outlet-level results.
  • Strengthen operating partnerships across multiple stakeholders by aligning Zone leadership, operations, sales, and frontline teams on agreed priorities across customers, channels, brands, and packages.
  • Assess differences in market potential and performance within North Zone; recommend priorities, resource needs, and segmented execution interventions to the Senior Director II, and implement agreed choices.
  • Participate in weekly and monthly performance routines, integrating revenue, volume, share, transactions, and execution indicators into clear diagnoses, named actions, and follow-through for North Zone
  • Identify root causes of performance gaps with bottler regional operations teams, agree on corrective actions, track recovery, adjust territory plans, and escalate unresolved risks with clear recommendations.
  • Manage assigned discretionary budgets within approved authority, balancing territory needs, expected returns, and bottler execution capacity; recommend investment trade-offs and additional resource needs.
  • Identify common execution and capability gaps across the region and build capabilities in partnership with Region Commercial, Intelligence, RTM, and other functional teams; share successful practices across bottlers.
  • Partner with Franchise Commercial leaders in the bi-monthly planning process, integrating customer, channel, marketing, finance, and supply-chain inputs into a coherent territory execution agenda with clear bottler commitments.
  • Maintain a regular in-market cadence across North Zone to validate outlet execution, learn from customers and frontline employees, identify barriers firsthand, and bring the voice of the market into bottler plans and our Region performance routines.
  • Foster a Growth Mindset by challenging assumptions, identifying new growth opportunities, and driving continuous improvement across the Coca-Cola system.
  • Model The Coca-Cola Company's leadership behaviors.

Qualifications & Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 7 or more years in a CPG organization across sales, key account, franchise management, or operations, including responsibility for business execution within an assigned market or geography.
  • Demonstrated success translating annual strategies into territory operating plans, forecasting performance, managing customer or distributor relationships, and leading corrective actions that improve business results.
  • Strong commercial and financial judgment, including experience with revenue and operating P&Ls, resource prioritization, selling, and negotiation in a complex franchise or entrepreneurial environment.
  • Strong understanding of channel marketing, customer and outlet execution, syndicated research, and competitive analysis, with the ability to combine data and frontline insights to identify execution priorities.

Core Accountabilities


Franchise Leadership

  • Build trusted partnerships and align bottler and Company priorities.
  • Influence strategic decisions and system growth initiatives.

Business Delivery

  • Deliver JBP commitments for Revenue, Volume, Transactions, Market Share, and Portfolio Growth.
  • Ensure key priorities are executed
  • Drive profitable and sustainable business outcomes.

Execution Excellence

  • Drive superior marketplace execution across the total beverage portfolio.
  • Improve Market Street Challenge performance.
  • Accelerate Execute and Sell & Hunt adoption and effectiveness.
  • Strengthening bottler capabilities and execution culture to win in the marketplace.

What We Can Do For You


  • Iconic Brand: Work on the most recognized brand in the world and be part of developing the next chapter.
  • Exposure to World-Class Leaders: Access to global marketing leaders who will expand your network and expose you to emerging digital platforms and marketing insights.
  • Learning Culture: Access to resources and management programs that give you the tools to continually develop your skills and knowledge.
All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form (Form I-9) upon hire.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

Our Quality Practice supports global Operations teams in delivering safe and effective products efficiently to more patients. Meta Description:Join Rutherford’s Talent Clearinghouse as an executive mentor, coach or specialist consultant supporting employee development through the Talent Accelerator.

Executive Mentors, Coaches & Specialist Consultants
Evergreen Expression of Interest — Rutherford Talent Clearinghouse™
Executive Talent Accelerator Programme
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Put your experience to work developing others

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced executives, professional coaches and subject-matter specialists who can help professionals strengthen their performance, develop their judgement and prepare for greater responsibility.

Through the Executive Talent Accelerator, Rutherford matches assessed employees of enterprise clients with development expertise suited to their objectives, behavioural profiles and organisational circumstances.

This posting recruits independent providers of mentoring, coaching and specialist consulting services. It is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not a current vacancy or a guaranteed assignment.

Augmenting internal career development

The Executive Talent Accelerator augments employers’ internal career and leadership development programmes with dedicated mentoring capacity, structured coaching and targeted specialist expertise.

Annual reviews can establish clear development priorities, but managers’ operational responsibilities may leave limited time for consistent guidance, practice and follow-up. Effective mentoring and coaching also require capabilities and interpersonal qualities that differ from those needed to manage performance.

Rutherford provides additional support to help employees act on agreed development objectives, working alongside their employer’s internal programme.

Three distinct ways to contribute

Executive Mentors

Provide longer-term, holistic guidance grounded in personal experience, career wisdom and relevant leadership responsibilities. Mentors help participants examine career direction, navigate organisational challenges, strengthen judgement and prepare for broader responsibilities.

Effective mentors explain their reasoning, share relevant experience and help participants develop their own judgement.

Executive Coaches

Provide structured, focused support for short-term skill development and performance improvement. Coaches help participants establish specific objectives, practise new approaches and review progress against agreed outcomes.

Assignments may address communication, delegation, stakeholder relationships, leadership behaviours or readiness for a defined responsibility.

Subject-Matter Specialist Consultants

Provide focused expertise addressing a particular functional, technical or business need. Specialists may explain a method, examine a decision, review work or help participants apply unfamiliar knowledge.

The scope, intended contribution and limits of the advice are established for each assignment. Implementation work is agreed separately.

Professionals may offer more than one service. Suitability and engagement scope are considered separately for each role.

Who should register

We welcome:

  • Current and former executives with relevant leadership experience and a demonstrated ability to develop others.
  • Professional coaches who can explain their methods, qualifications and evidence of contribution.
  • Senior functional and technical specialists who can translate expertise into practical learning.
  • Experienced consultants interested in supporting enterprise-sponsored development.

A distinguished career or senior title alone does not establish mentoring or coaching capability. We look for evidence that you can listen, explain, challenge appropriately and adapt your approach to another person’s needs.

Assessment and matching

Rutherford evaluates providers across three complementary areas:

  • Functional expertise:demonstrated knowledge, judgement and relevant experience.
  • Development capability:the ability to mentor, coach or teach effectively within the service offered.
  • Service orientation and relationship fit:the motivation and interpersonal capacity to support another person’s progress.

The RutherfordINTEL Assessment informs curator review alongside professional history, qualifications, references and examples of developmental work.

Matching considers the employee’s objectives, behavioural profile, enterprise context and practical needs, together with the provider’s expertise, approach and availability.

Working with Rutherford and enterprise clients

Rutherford International markets the Executive Talent Accelerator, holds and manages the enterprise client relationship, coordinates development mandates and matches providers to participating employees.

Providers deliver agreed services as independent contractors to Rutherford International. Each assignment establishes the scope, objectives, professional fees, time commitment, reporting requirements and engagement terms.

Providers are expected to:

  • Prepare thoroughly and deliver relevant, actionable guidance.
  • Maintain accurate timesheets and submit them through the agreed process.
  • Support development objectives aligned with the client’s internal programme.
  • Respect confidentiality and agreed information-sharing boundaries.
  • Disclose conflicts and work within their professional competence.
  • Distinguish developmental support from management authority or separately commissioned implementation work.
  • Review progress and raise concerns when the match or scope needs to change.

Employer sponsorship does not automatically provide access to private assessment results or confidential development discussions.

Assessment, membership and assignment fees

Initial expression of interest — Free

Registering creates no payment obligation.

Assessment and feedback — USD $250

If invited to proceed, this stage includes behavioural and leadership profiling, relevant benchmark interpretation and professional feedback.

Clearinghouse directory membership — USD $125 per month, with a 12-month term

For accepted members, membership includes assistance with the Rutherford Consultant Thesis™, business-development profiling, talent promotion, lead generation, sector research community access and career or project-success advisory support.

Rutherford-managed Accelerator assignments

Rutherford invoices the enterprise client for agreed services delivered by the provider.

Rutherford retains20% of professional billings, excluding applicable taxes. The provider receives the remaining80% of professional billings, subject to the agreed engagement terms.

This service fee isadditional to the monthly directory membership feeand reflects Rutherford’s client acquisition, matching, programme coordination, client relationship management and billing responsibilities.

Membership does not guarantee assignments or income.

Conversion to employment

If a consulting assignment converts to employment with the contracting client, the client pays a conversion fee of25% of annual salary and bonus income before six months from the assignment’s start, or20% from six months to one year.

Rutherford International retains agency rights for12 months after the consulting assignment ends.

Register your interest

Select“I’m interested”to complete Rutherford International’s Talent Registration form.

Indicate whether you wish to be considered as an executive mentor, executive coach, subject-matter specialist consultant or a combination of these roles.

Following initial review, a curator may invite you to provide further information and proceed to assessment and membership consideration.

Registration does not guarantee acceptance, representation, a client introduction or an assignment.

Inside Sales Representative (Part Time Internship, Remote)

Storage Scholars is a high-growth company that’s undergone 100% year-over-year growth since its inception in 2017. Our goal is to change the way college students across the country move in and out of residence halls with our all-inclusive moving, storage and shipping service. Storage Scholars is fast-moving, tenacious, innovative, and core-product-focused. We strive to be the premium option among the competition by offering the best user experience available, which is dependent on continuously improving our technology. We expect passion and buy-in from every team member, no matter the role. We believe everyone, regardless of their position, brings unique knowledge, skills, and perspective that makes us who we are. All voices are not just welcomed but encouraged to be a part of the decisions and direction of the organization. At Storage Scholars, egos are left at the door, wins are celebrated as a team, and learning never stops.

As an Inside Sales Representative (Part Time Internship) at Storage Scholars, your primary responsibility is being a consultative guide for customers seeking solutions for student move-in, move-out, storage, and shipping. As a member of the greater Customer Experience Team, you will be a crucial link between the customer and their understanding and adoption of the services that we offer.

What you’ll do:

  • Field inbound leads from both lead form submissions and inbound calls.
  • Make proactive phone calls to existing and former customers to promote service usage.
  • Provide service estimates for customers via call, SMS, and email.
  • Guide customers through their order flow in our online portal to book their moves.
  • Promote additional services and service upgrades to customers, as well as generate referrals.

Required:

  • Exceptional communication with strong sales aptitude.
  • Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced changes and intense workloads.
  • Strong phone presence.
  • High emotional intelligence to understand fellow team members and clients alike.
  • Technologically savvy, with the ability to learn new software rapidly.

Preferred:

  • 1–2 years of customer-facing experience (such as retail, hospitality, or customer service).

Scope:

  • Part time, seasonal role: 15–25 hours/week on average, up to 40 hours/week during March - May.
  • The ability to work a flexible schedule on evenings and weekends as necessary during our peak season (March - September).
  • Preferred Start Date: 1/25/27
  • Tentative End Date: 8/1/27

Compensation:

  • Estimated seasonal earnings: $4,500 – $10,000+
  • Base pay plus per-customer commission. Earnings depend on hours worked (15–25 hrs/week) and monthly sales performance.

Other Benefits:

  • Fully Remote
  • Ability to grow with our rapidly growing company and team.

Location:

  • Remote

How Our Core Service Works:

Customers sign up on our web portal to schedule services on their respective campuses. Packing supply kits are shipped out to students as requested. The student packs their items, uploads a few photos to our portal, selects their desired insurance, locks it in their room, and can leave at will. Thanks to our partnership with the university, our staff comes in once the campus is vacant and moves all of the student belongings into a storage facility for the summer. The best part is that the items will be ready and waiting in the customer’s new housing assignment whenever they return.

Storage Scholars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salary: $4,500 – $10,000 / year
