raw.description:
Rapid7's vulnerability intelligence team does industry-leading offensive research that helps organizations worldwide understand and prioritize real risk. When a critical vulnerability starts getting exploited in the wild, we're the team that figures out what's actually happening, how bad it is, and what defenders need to do about it. We're looking for an experienced vulnerability researcher to help lead that work, with a strong focus on rapid n-day analysis and on making Metasploit better for the security community.


About the Team

Rapid7 vulnerability researchers analyze high-priority n-day vulnerabilities, write Metasploit modules, find and publish zero-day vulnerabilities, and help customers, the media, internal teams, and the public understand which threats matter and why. We drive Rapid7's company-wide Emergent Threat Response (ETR) program, coordinating our research, product coverage, and customer guidance when widespread attacks hit. We aren't satisfied with being purely reactive, though. We also look for the vulnerabilities and attack patterns that will become tomorrow's widespread threats.


About the Role

This role sits at the Staff level, a senior technical leadership position on our individual contributor track. Your time will be focused primarily on Emergent Threat Response and Metasploit, with zero-day research as a secondary focus.


Primary focus: Emergent Threat Response (n-day research)

  • Rapidly analyze newly disclosed and actively exploited vulnerabilities, often under tight timelines, to determine root cause, exploitability, and real-world impact
  • Reproduce vulnerabilities and build working exploits from patch diffs, advisories, and limited public information, documenting behavioral differences across affected versions and platforms
  • Publish clear, technically rigorous root cause analyses that help defenders act quickly and reflect Rapid7's attacker-focused approach to vulnerability intelligence
  • Advise detection and vulnerability check engineers as they build coverage, and help internal teams and customers understand what's urgent, what isn't, and why
  • Serve as a go-to expert during high-velocity events (think Log4Shell), knowing when to raise alarms and when to counsel patience

Primary focus: Metasploit

  • Develop and contribute high-quality exploit modules to Metasploit, especially for high-priority vulnerabilities coming out of ETR work
  • Drive improvements to the Metasploit Framework itself, including new capabilities, tooling, library enhancements, and quality improvements that make the framework more effective for researchers and practitioners
  • Review community and internal module contributions, raising the bar for code qua
  • lity, reliability, and stability across the project
  • Partner with the Metasploit engineering team on roadmap priorities and help shape where the framework goes next

Secondary focus: Zero-day research

  • Identify and research, new vulnerabilities in technologies that matter to enterprise organizations
  • Help define longer-term research priorities with the broader team, bringing a point of view on emerging attack surface

Across all of it

  • Contribute technical trend analysis to Rapid7's research reports and publications
  • Represent the team's work through conference talks, webcasts, blog posts, and media engagements
  • Mentor and develop other researchers through code review, pairing, documentation, and technical guidance
  • Explain technical risk clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to executives

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • Demonstrable expertise across most major vulnerability classes and exploitation techniques, with the ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and attacks quickly and effectively
  • Experience developing complex exploit chains from scratch, including from patch diffs or minimal public detail
  • Strong reverse engineering and binary/code diffing skills, including against large codebases or binaries
  • Expert-level understanding of networking, operating system internals for one or more major OSes, and/or bypassing common exploit mitigations
  • A track record of writing about vulnerabilities and exploits for a public audience, and of speaking about your research at conferences, on webcasts, or similar venues
  • The ability to build custom tooling as needed and to scope work into clear milestones rather than monolithic deliverables
  • A willingness to mentor and teach. You don't need to be a people manager, but you should enjoy making the people around you better.
  • Communicate in a clear manner that conveys objectives and rationale when explaining complex attack patterns and risks to technical stakeholders and detection engineers.
  • Eager and open to understanding "why" a change is happening, acting as an active driver of it, and focusing forward versus in the past to tackle emerging threats.
  • Hold self and others responsible for driving outcomes and meeting commitments that deliver value for the business and our customers by establishing ownership within research projects.
  • Experience working cross-functionally during time-sensitive security events and translating technical findings for non-technical stakeholders
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

Nice to Have

  • Published zero-day vulnerabilities and CVEs
  • Prior contributions to the Metasploit Framework or other open source security projects
  • Media training or experience speaking with journalists
  • Experience applying AI or LLM-based tooling to accelerate vulnerability research or exploit development

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams, reflecting a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you're excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy. Apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.


Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.


The annual salary range for this role, depending on location, is:

United States: $156 400,00 - 211 600,00 USD Annual

Salary ranges may vary based on geographical location. This range does not include variable/incentive compensation, equity and benefits (where applicable/eligible).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

As a Senior Product Manager I, you will own a product or a substantial area within Interfolio’s Faculty Information System. You will develop product strategy, lead discovery, and guide delivery from concept through launch, creating value for customers and supporting business outcomes. Working in a dynamic environment, you will collaborate across functions, use evidence to inform decisions, and help teams deliver meaningful improvements through iterative product

development.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and communicate a product vision and roadmap aligned with customer needs and business strategy.
  • Prioritise opportunities using customer value, commercial potential, delivery effort, and technical constraints.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?


THE OPPORTUNITY


Silvus is seeking a Business Development Engineer, USSOCOM to join the Applications Engineering team. This role is structured for early- to mid-career candidates seeking to bridge technical radio frequency capabilities with Special Operations Command customer requirements and emerging trends.


Reporting to the Director of Applications Engineering, you will work alongside Engineering and Business Development teams to support USSOCOM acquisition stakeholders and Component Commands. In this position, you will assist in demonstrating the technical capabilities, interoperability, low-signature performance, and field-readiness of our StreamCaster MANET radio portfolio across multi-domain, tactical edge, and uncrewed environments. This role requires up to 50% travel to customer sites, research laboratories, and strategic field-testing environments, with a 100% remote working option depending on location.


The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.


ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in analyzing USSOCOM capability gaps, SOF-peculiar communications requirements, and Hyper-Enabled Operator/tactical edge network design goals, mapping operational needs to tactical radio solutions.
  • Support technical planning, network configuration, and live-on-the-air execution of field trials, modernizations, and user evaluations.
  • Collaborate with the Applications Engineering team to leverage continuous testing and competitive benchmarking data, helping verify that proposed solution architectures are technically sound.
  • Maintain close alignment with the Business Development team to support their ongoing technical needs and align work with established strategic priorities.
  • Assist in building and presenting technical demonstrations tailored to low-signature, resilient, and tactical edge operational needs of USSOCOM and its component commands (USASOC, NAVSPECWARCOM, AFSOC, MARSOC).
  • Contribute technical input and review support for RFI/RFP proposal responses.
  • Perform market research to identify potential integrations with industry partners and test end-to-end network architectures.
  • Assist Business Development in engaging with technical stakeholders across USSOCOM PEO-SOF Digital Applications / PEO-C4, SOF AT&L, SOFWERX, and Component Command Science & Technology (S&T) leads.
  • Serve as an internal voice for the SOF Operator by gathering field feedback, signature management requirements, and operational needs, helping translate them into product roadmap inputs, and tracking engineering progress against operational needs.
  • Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
  • Travel Requirement – 50%; frequent travel to customer sites, research laboratories, and strategic field-testing environments.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related C5ISR field with 2–5 years of demonstrated experience in systems engineering, technical business development, or defense technology roles; OR High School Diploma/GED with 5+ years of relevant technical or defense experience.
  • Exposure to or working knowledge of Software-Defined Radios (SDRs), IP-based routing protocols, or tactical communication systems.
  • Basic familiarity with RF test equipment, such as spectrum analyzers and signal generators.
  • Security Clearance: Active U.S. Government SECRET clearance or the ability to obtain one within 15 months of hire.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen due to clients under U.S. government contracts.
  • All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Basic understanding of USSOCOM procurement pathways (SOF AT&L, PEO-C4, SOFWERX OTAs) and operational needs across USASOC, NAVSPECWARCOM, AFSOC, and MARSOC.
  • Familiarity with Low Probability of Intercept / Low Probability of Detection (LPI/LPD), anti-jamming tactics, or signature management in contested/spectrum-denied environments.
  • Practical experience with TCP/IP networking, Linux environments, or scripting languages (e.g., Python, C++) for test automation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts effectively.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote team setting.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Conferences, technical symposiums, and trade shows.
  • Outdoor environment for large-scale field trials and tactical demonstrations.
  • Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in rugged field environments.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following:
    • Lift equipment up to 50 lbs. for the set-up of complex tactical network demonstrations and testing.

Job Title: Investor Relations Multifamily Investments (Remote)

About Us

Aligned Ventures is a fast-growing multifamily investment firm built on trust, execution, and alignment with investors. We are investors first and sponsors second, our principle backs the company with a 30 million dollar balance sheet and we invested 8 figures of our capital before deciding bringing in outside investors. We continue to invest alongside our investors in every deal, and were scaling our assets in Texas. Our mission is simple: create a best-in-class platform that delivers outsized returns and earns long-term investor confidence.

About the Role

Were looking for a high-performing Investor Relations Associate who knows how to build trust, move capital, and manage relationships with precision. This isn't an order-taking or marketing-hand-off role. You'll be sourcing and advising accredited investors, understanding their goals, and walking them through opportunities from first call to close. If you've raised capital or sold high-value investments before, and you understand the difference between interest and commitment, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Do

  • Source investors thru various marketing channels that you will design, launch and initiate.

  • Maintain long-term investor relationships with consistent communication and transparency.

  • Represent the firm at investor events, conferences, and webinars.
  • Collaborate with leadership to continually refine our investor communication strategy.

What Success Looks Like

  • $1M+ raised within your first 90 days.

  • $10M+ raised by year one.

Who You Are

raw.description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, trusted by thousands of web publishers and app developers across the globe. By blending proprietary AI technology with elite optimization techniques, we safeguard and maximize publisher revenue. We are a culture-centric, 100% remote organization that heavily values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules.and schedule autonomy. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

We are seeking a Group Product Manager (GPM) who is both a world-class operator and an player- coach. In this role, you will have the dual responsibility:

  1. Champion Product Excellence: You will mentor and guide other Product Managers across MonetizeMore, transforming our product organization into a best-in-class, outcome-driven Product Operating Model (inspired by modern frameworks like Marty Cagan’s Silicon Valley Product Group).
  2. Own the Product Management for Advanced Ads (Interim): You will drive the strategy, growth, and execution of Advanced Ads—our leading ad-management platform powering over 150,000 websites worldwide.

You don't just build features to check boxes; you build solutions that move the needle on business goals, and you enable the PMs on your team to do the same.

Core Responsibilities

1. Leadership & Product Operating Model Excellence

  • Mentorship & Coaching: Serve as a player-coach to other Product Managers, guiding them to elevate their product craft, execution, and strategic thinking.
  • Outcome over Output: Evangelize the shift from feature-factory mindsets to an outcome-driven culture. Train PMs to obsess over business results and customer impact rather than sprint velocity and story points.
  • Framework Standardizing: Implement modern product operating model principles (e.g., product trios, data-informed decision making, rapid prototyping, and de-risking assumptions).
  • Evangelize Kaizen: Introduce continuous feedback loops and structured retrospective frameworks to scale product management maturity across the entire organization.

2. Product Ownership: Advanced Ads

  • Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the long-term product vision for Advanced Ads, integrating its flexible ad injection, targeting, and Google Ad Manager capabilities deeper into the MonetizeMore ecosystem.
  • Continuous Discovery: Lead continuous product discovery to uncover publishers' deepest pain points, validating ideas for usability, feasibility, viability, and value before writing code.
  • Revenue & Growth: Take end-to-end ownership from monetization strategy to GTM. Prioritize the roadmap based on clear ROI, keeping a laser focus on customer lifetime value (LTV) and monthly recurring revenue (MRR).
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Growth to ensure features aren't just shipped, but successfully adopted and commercialized.
  • Long-Term Plan: Determine the long term needs of this business line: resource requirements, investment, propose and collaborate on the best organizational design for the success of the product.
Who You Are
  • The Experienced Leader: You have 8+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years leading or mentoring other PMs. Ad tech, SaaS, or WordPress ecosystem experience is a massive plus.
  • The Operating Model Expert: You have deeply practical experience working within a modern, empowerment-based Product Operating Model. You know what "good" looks like and possess the empathy and patience to coach others there.
  • The Owner Mindset: You treat your product like your own business. You aren't afraid to dive into raw data to find hidden patterns or jump on a customer call to understand friction points.
  • Data-Driven & Courageous: You monitor product health metrics religiously. If the data shows a feature is failing to deliver the expected outcome, you have the courage to pivot or kill it.
  • The Clear Communicator: You effortlessly translate complex technical logic or abstract product frameworks into digestible, high-impact value propositions for stakeholders, engineers, and your team.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with a flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.


Assessment Requirement: As part of our hiring process, all applicants who pass the resume screening will be required to complete a TestDome assessment. Only candidates who successfully pass the assessment will be invited to proceed to the Culture Fit Interview.

The Role:

The incumbent is a member of the AML Investigations Team reporting directly to the Head of Investigation Team, with a dotted line to the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO). The incumbent will also work closely with other Compliance and Customer Support teams, and peer AML Investigators in addressing both fraud and money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risks.

The incumbent will maintain and develop strong relationships and network amongst peers in the industry to learn and share best practices and investigative techniques.

In performing the role, the incumbent will continuously strive to continuously self-develop and enhance their skill sets incl. understanding blockchain technology, virtual currencies, suspicious activities in the space, criminals’ modus operandi and best investigative practices to mitigate against the risk of money laundering, financing terrorism or violating sanctions on behalf of Bitfinex and to ensure the company’s robust Regulatory Compliance requirements.

  • Demonstrated AML experience incl. customer and enhanced due diligence (CDD/EDD), AML/CTF/Sanctions Investigations, SAR/STR reporting

Skills:

Companisto ist das führende digitale Business-Angel-Netzwerk in der D-A-CH-Region. Über 6.200 aktive Investoren haben bereits mehr als 320 Millionen Euro in Startups und Wachstumsunternehmen investiert.

Was bedeutet das für dich?

Das bewegst du bei Companisto

raw.title: Director, Electrical Engineering
raw.excerpt: Who we are For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.
raw.description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

Scope of Role:

The Director of Electrical Engineering leads the Electrical Design Engineering team and is accountable for all electrical design activities supporting the Energy-from-Waste process across more than 30 facilities across North America. This role provides design leadership for electrical infrastructure across high-voltage (26 kV to 230 kV), medium-voltage (5 kV to 13.8 kV), and low-voltage systems, including high-voltage breakers, step-up transformers, turbine generators, balance-of-plant equipment, medium-voltage switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), fans and motors, protective relaying, and short-circuit and arc-flash studies.

The Electrical Design Engineering team also supports a broad range of plant systems and disciplines, including steam generation boilers and auxiliaries, feedwater pumps, deaerator systems, turbine generators, condensers, air pollution control equipment, ash handling and conveying equipment, and metals recovery systems. This position leads a team of electrical subject matter experts (SMEs) supporting key growth initiatives, including routine capital projects, major plant expansions, and feasibility studies for new facilities. Annual capital and maintenance reinvestment at Reworld exceeds $300 million and supports long-term assets planning. While this is a corporate engineering role, it requires extensive collaboration with site/regional teams; approximately 30% of travel is expected.

Reporting to the Vice President of Engineering, this role also supports talent development, goal settings, budgeting, resource planning, feasibility studies, and project prioritizations. The Director Electrical Engineering, partners closely with cross-functional leaders, including Plant Support Engineering, Sourcing, PMO, Operations, Electrical Field Services, and Regional Engineering, to ensure discipline needs are met. The position may also support business development efforts by providing technical expertise and resourcing input.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical:

  • Discipline/Design Engineering: Manage, prioritize, and assign work across the Electrical Engineering team and SMEs.
  • Capital Projects: Lead electrical infrastructure design engineering for capital projects.
  • Technical Programs: Lead technical programs of strategic importance to the company.
  • Technical Standards: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Reworld’s Electrical specifications/design standards library.
  • Operations Support: Provide engineering support to operations, including evaluation and implementation of technology upgrades aligned with the business needs.
  • External Engineering Partners: Engage and manage outside engineering firms to deliver technically sound, business-feasible electrical designs.
  • Front-End Loading (FEL): Lead front-end design activities for capital projects in alignment with FEL processes and tools.
  • Coaching and Mentoring: Mentor, coach, and develop SMEs, including training on FEL tools and best practices.
  • Feasibility Studies: Lead feasibility studies for new or retrofit designs, evaluating total cost of ownership (Capital and O&M) and recommending solutions that balance technical and economic considerations.

Continuous Improvement and EHS:

  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Problem Solving: Lead RCAs and coach SMEs in problem-solving methodologies to implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Lessons Learned: Drive the lessons learned program, incorporate site feedback, and update standards and specifications to improve future designs.
  • Productivity and Unscheduled Downtime: Lead improvement initiatives to reduce downtime and deliver operational savings across facilities.
  • Technical Risk Assessment: Lead technical risk assessments for electrical designs and retrofits, including SEOLDS, arc-flash studies, and protective relaying scheme reviews.
  • Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA): Lead FMEA activities to support critical troubleshooting and reliability improvements at site locations.
  • Low-Cost Country Sourcing: Perform Technical Due Diligence and provide recommendations for Projects involving Equipment sourcing from Low-cost countries.

Leadership:

  • Talent Management: Attract, develop, and retain talent; lead performance management processes for internal teams.
  • Professional Development: Provide guidance and support for talent development of Engineering SMEs.

REQUIREMENTS:

Education:

  • Bachelor of Engineering/Science (Electrical Engineering) from an accredited institution.

Experience:

  • 15–20 years of experience in an electrical engineering role, including at least five years of leadership experience.
  • Prior electrical design engineering experience in one or more of the following (or similar) industries:
    • Architectural Engineering firms
    • Data centers
    • Power generating plants
    • Large industrial facilities (Chemical, paper, co-generation or similar industries)
  • Experience with MV and HV systems (e.g., switchgear, motor control centers, protective relaying, transformers).
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical teams is required.
  • Experience across the project execution lifecycle preferred: concept design, construction, commissioning, and start-ups.
  • Experience supporting facility operations and/or maintenance is preferred.
  • Technical due diligence experience for equipment sourcing from Low-cost countries (e.g. in Asia) will be a plus.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze data and identify trends.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with key stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with minimal direction while providing guidance and support to a technical team of direct and indirect reports.

Certifications (preferred):

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license in the United States is highly desired.
  • Six Sigma certification (minimum Green Belt) is highly desired.

In addition to salary, this role is eligible for benefits. The benefits would include medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental plans; 401(k) plan; paid parental leave; paid time off; and paid holidays.

Additional details are available at .

For additional information, refer to the Pay Transparency section below.

Please note that Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

Pay Transparency

The range below reflects Reworld’s reasonable estimate of base pay for this role based on primary posting location. It is expected that most qualified candidates in this location will fall within the posting range. Pay ranges are reviewed from time to time and may be modified in the future.

For more information regarding these offerings, please visit the Reworld Careers Benefits Page. raw.title: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) & Co-founder - AI for Small Law Firms
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityAI is changing the economics of legal practice.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.

Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still operate with many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.

BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.

The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.

We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.

Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes — calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved — not on how much software they configure themselves.

Our AI workforce starts with two teammates:

Ava — AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.

Claire — AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.

Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.

They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice — including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles — all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the technology and deployment infrastructure are being built for scale.

What remains is to complete the founding team with a commercial co-founder — someone who will own revenue and go-to-market with the same conviction, urgency, and sense of ownership as the CEO and CTO.

This is not a role where you inherit a sales team, a mature playbook, and a predictable funnel. You will help discover and build those things.

You will personally close early customers, determine which channels scale, refine the commercial model from real market evidence, and then build the organization capable of repeating it.

This is a co-founder and leadership role, not simply a sales hire. You will join the CEO and CTO as one of three co-founders, with founder-level equity, founder-level responsibility, and a meaningful voice in go-to-market, pricing, hiring, fundraising, product direction, and company strategy.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CRO, you will own the commercial journey from first conversation through acquisition, retention, and expansion.

  • Early Revenue — Personally convert pilots and prospects into paying customers and establish the first repeatable sales motion across solo practitioners and firms of up to five lawyers.

  • Go-to-Market — Refine and operationalize our ICP, positioning, messaging, and Rise of the Solo narrative, turning them into outreach, demos, pipeline, and closed revenue.

  • Pipeline & Channels — Determine which acquisition channels actually work — outbound, content, paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, communities, events, and others — and concentrate resources behind the ones that can scale.

  • Partnerships & Distribution — Build relationships with legal business coaches, bar associations, legal communities, consultants, complementary technology providers, and other potential distribution partners.

  • Pricing & Commercial Economics — Own pricing, packaging, expansion strategy, customer acquisition economics, retention targets, and the path toward increasing revenue per firm as the AI workforce expands.

  • Customer Success & Retention — Stay close to early customers, understand why they buy and why they stay, and build the commercial processes that turn adoption into retention, expansion, referrals, and advocacy.

  • Customer Proof — Turn early wins into measurable case studies, testimonials, references, and commercial proof around the outcomes lawyers care about.

  • Fundraising — Help tell the growth story to investors through credible traction, metrics, unit economics, forecasts, and a clear path to scale.

  • Team — Once the motion is working, recruit and lead the sales, partnerships, and customer-success organization needed to scale it.

Co-Founder Profile

We're looking for a builder first and a sales executive second.

You are likely someone who has spent enough time inside an established company to know how a professional revenue organization works — but would rather build one than inherit one.

You should bring:

  • A strong record of full-cycle selling, ideally into the legal market or another fragmented SMB/professional-services vertical.

  • The confidence to personally prospect, run demos, negotiate, close, onboard, and expand early customers before hiring people to do it for you.

  • A strong understanding of how small-business buyers make decisions, what creates trust, and how to turn an early-stage product into a compelling commercial proposition.

  • Ideally, an existing network within legal technology, solo and small-firm legal communities, bar associations, legal services, or adjacent channels.

  • Strong commercial judgment — including the willingness to challenge assumptions about positioning, pricing, channels, or markets when the evidence says we should.

  • Entrepreneurial drive: you are ready to move from selling someone else's company to building one of your own.

  • Comfort with an early-stage compensation model weighted heavily toward ownership and revenue creation rather than a conventional executive salary.

  • The ability to operate as a principal, not an employee — making decisions with the long-term value of the company in mind and doing whatever work is necessary at this stage to move it forward.

Early-stage go-to-market leadership, experience selling AI or automation products, and experience selling into the legal profession are strongly preferred. Candidates should be able to operate effectively across North American time zones.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleRetail is where COROS meets athletes in person, and across Europe it is the channel with the most room to grow and the one we are investing in now.
raw.description:
About the Role

Retail is where COROS meets athletes in person, and across Europe it is the channel with the most room to grow and the one we are investing in now. The Retail Marketing Manager Europe turns that potential into presence, owning the marketing layer on top of our distributor and retail partner relationships across the continent. That covers digital and physical campaigns and activations, point-of-sale displays, shop windows, in-store presence and retail marketing materials, designed, sourced, produced and brought to life in five direct markets plus our distributor-led territories.

The role is also the internal interface for European leadership and sales: Country Managers and Sales Managers bring their market needs here, and this role turns them into briefs, materials and campaigns, working directly with our headquarters teams and with our US counterparts as peers. The operating principle is to build centrally and roll out locally. This role designs the European solution (concept, materials and a ready-to-use execution toolkit), and the country teams, led by the Sales Managers, run the local rollout with this role as central support. The role reports directly to the Head of Europe.

Your playground

  • Develop and execute marketing activations and campaigns with retailers and partners across Europe, in both digital and physical channels.

  • Own the marketing layer of our partner relationships: in-store presence, shop window concepts, point-of-sale displays, retail campaign mechanics and co-marketing execution.

  • Act as the single point of contact for Country Managers and Sales Managers on retail marketing needs: translate market requirements into briefs and ready-to-use toolkits, hand them to the country teams for local rollout, and keep visibility of the pipeline across all markets.

  • Brief and manage POS and display design, source and commission suppliers, manage production timelines, and coordinate distribution and stock of retail materials across European markets.

  • Localise and adapt global assets where they exist, and develop European solutions where they don't.

  • Project manage the European rollout of product launches, working between the European sales organisation and the global brand team so retail and partner execution is ready on time.

  • Design the shop staff engagement programme (product knowledge, training formats and incentive thinking) and hand it to the market teams to run with their retail partners.

  • Develop community-facing activation formats, such as community runs, where they serve retail and partner objectives.

  • Prepare and facilitate the recurring European retail review with the Head of Europe and the Country Managers, where the pipeline is prioritised across markets.

  • Work with the retail and events function in the US as a peer, and engage directly with the headquarters teams in China on asset and material requirements.

  • Track performance across retail presence and activation effectiveness, and use the data to decide where effort and spend go next.

  • Make independent spending decisions within approved projects, and bring opportunities forward proactively rather than waiting for direction.

What you bring to the starting line

Professional Background

  • Experience: 5 years+ in retail marketing, trade marketing or brand activation, ideally in sports, outdoor, consumer electronics or a comparable branded goods environment.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • Retail Execution: Proven track record of bringing a brand to life at the point of sale (POS concepts, in-store presence, retail campaigns) with measurable results.

  • Production and Sourcing: Hands-on experience briefing design, commissioning suppliers, managing production timelines and getting physical material where it needs to be, on time and on budget.

  • Multi-Market Work: Experience working across several time zones, cultures and markets with differing needs, and comfort as the connecting point between commercial stakeholders with varying priorities.

  • Launch Management: Experience running the marketing side of product launches across channels and markets.

Other Key Requirements

  • Collaboration and Organization: Strong project management, excellent communication, and the ability to keep many parallel workstreams moving without losing the detail.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated and resourceful. You propose rather than wait.

  • Language: Fluency in English, spoken and written. An additional European language is a plus.

  • Mobility: Willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

  • Flexibility: Willingness to occasionally work evenings or weekends around activations and events, with time off in lieu.

How the role will grow

COROS Europe is growing fast, and this role is built to grow with it. As individual markets develop enough retail volume to justify their own dedicated retail resource, the scope of this role is likely to shift: less breadth across markets, more depth in the ones that remain. How that plays out will depend on how the business develops and on the strengths the person in this role brings. This is a function being built rather than inherited, and the person building it will shape what it becomes.

The Setup

  • Reporting Line: Head of Europe.

  • Scope: Five direct European markets plus distributor-led territories.

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in the EU or the UK, ideally close to a major airport. Wherever you're based, we'll set you up with a local employment contract.

  • Working Mode: Fully remote or hybrid if you live close to an office location, with occasional team get-togethers.

  • Job Type: Full-time.

Package & Benefits

  • Work in a motivated, international team.

  • Build a function from the ground up in the channel with the most room to grow.

  • Space for ideas and independent work.

  • Flat hierarchy with short decision-making processes.

  • 25 days of paid vacation plus standard local holidays.

  • COROS products and discounts for family & friends.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this position starts at €55.000,- annually with the possibility to earn a performance-based bonus on top. This is the least we can do for you. The final offer depends on your experience, background, and location.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Workday Compensation Configuration Lead serves as the enterprise subject matter expert for Workday Compensation and related Total Rewards technology solutions. This role partners with Compensation, HR, Finance, Payroll, and Technology stakeholders to design, configure, implement, and optimize scalable compensation solutions that support business objectives, regulatory requirements, and the associate experience. The Lead provides strategic guidance on Workday capabilities, compensation processes, and leading practices while advising senior leaders on enterprise initiatives, governance, and technology investments that maximize the value of the organization's Workday platform.

The Workday Compensation Configuration Lead is responsible for leading the strategy, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and ongoing support of Workday Compensation solutions. This role serves as the functional owner for compensation-related processes including annual compensation planning, incentive and bonus programs, compensation eligibility, salary structures, market adjustments, one-time payments, and compensation statements. The Lead evaluates business requirements, provides solution recommendations, and translates complex compensation needs into sustainable system capabilities.

Working as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders, this role drives continuous improvement, identifies opportunities for automation and process optimization, and evaluates new Workday functionality to maximize business value. The Lead leads complex initiatives, assesses cross-functional impacts, supports governance and release management activities, and provides advanced troubleshooting for critical production issues.

As a senior subject matter expert, the role influences enterprise strategy, mentors team members, and provides recommendations to leadership on matters with significant operational, financial, compliance, and associate experience impacts.

Attributes for success:

  • Deep expertise in Workday Advanced Compensation and compensation administration with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, sustainable solutions.
  • Strong strategic consulting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence decisions and provide recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and solution tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives, balance competing priorities, and drive continuous improvement through governance, automation, and optimization
  • Proven ability to provide strategic recommendations, influence business decisions, and lead complex projects or workstreams in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Experience partnering with Compensation, Total Rewards, HR, Finance, Payroll, Technology, and other business stakeholders to deliver enterprise-wide solutions.


Use your skills to make an impact


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 7+ years of HR technology, HRIS, enterprise systems, or related experience, including significant experience leading complex configuration initiatives.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience with deep expertise in Workday Advanced Compensation and related HCM functionality.
  • Experience configuring and supporting compensation processes, including annual compensation planning, merit increases, bonus and incentive programs, compensation eligibility, salary structures, and one-time payments.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering business requirements, conducting solution design, and translating complex business needs into scalable Workday solutions.
  • Experience leading testing activities, including unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), release validation, and production deployment.

Preferred skills:

  • Workday Pro certification or accreditation in Compensation, Advanced Compensation, HCM, or a related Workday discipline.
  • Experience leading large-scale Workday implementations, optimization initiatives, or enterprise compensation transformations.
  • Strong knowledge of compensation structures, job architecture, market pricing, salary grade administration, and annual compensation planning processes.
  • Experience with Workday reporting, dashboards, Prism Analytics, calculated fields, and data-driven decision support.
  • Experience mentoring configuration professionals and influencing technology strategy within a large, complex enterprise environment.

Additional information:

  • In this role you will be an independent contributor
  • This role will not have travel.
  • This role will be fully remote within the U.S.
  • This role is not open to Sponsorship.
  • You will report to an Associate Director.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$117,600 - $161,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-06-2026

Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


What You Will Do

The Senior Manager, SAP ERP Transformation - Plan to Sustain (Field Service Management & Integration) is a critical leadership role responsible for driving the design, development, integration, and deployment of enterprise Field Service Management (FSM) processes and capabilities within RTX’s SAP S/4HANA transformation.


This position will lead the standardization and integration of Field Service Management capabilities across RTX business units, including Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon. The role requires strategic leadership, strong knowledge of field service operations, SAP ERP implementation methodologies, and the ability to align business requirements with enterprise technology solutions. The Senior Manager will collaborate with business and digital technology leaders to establish standardized field service processes, enable system integration, and support operational efficiency across the enterprise.


  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise Field Service Management processes and capabilities within the SAP S/4HANA Plan to Sustain transformation.
  • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, and resources associated with Field Service Management process development, system integration, and deployment.
  • Define and standardize end-to-end Field Service Management processes, including service requests, work order management, technician scheduling and dispatch, field service execution, service confirmation, and service order completion.
  • Ensure seamless integration of Field Service Management processes with SAP S/4HANA and supporting enterprise applications, including service management, maintenance, inventory, procurement, finance, and customer service.
  • Partner with RTX business units to identify operational requirements, evaluate process variations, and establish standardized enterprise solutions while addressing approved business-specific needs.
  • Collaborate with Digital Technology, system integrators, and cross-functional process teams to define functional requirements, integration points, and solution design specifications.
  • Provide leadership and oversight of Field Service Management solution development, configuration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with Field Service Management process changes, system integrations, data dependencies, and operational transitions.
  • Communicate project progress, key decisions, risks, and strategic recommendations to vice presidents, senior leaders, and business stakeholders.
  • Lead organizational change management activities to support adoption of standardized Field Service Management processes, technology solutions, and operating procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve technician productivity, service execution efficiency, resource utilization, and operational visibility through SAP S/4HANA and integrated Field Service Management technologies.
  • Manage relationships with system integrators, technology providers, and implementation partners to ensure quality, accountability, and timely solution delivery.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to Field Service Management performance, including service response times, first-time fix rates, work order completion, technician utilization, and service execution efficiency.
  • Support enterprise governance, process documentation, and solution standardization to ensure consistency, compliance, and alignment with RTX transformation objectives.
  • Mentor and develop team members while promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the Plan to Sustain organization.
  • Ability to travel up to 30%.

What You Will Learn

  • As part of the Plan to Sustain organization, the Senior Manager, Field Service Management & Integration will play a key leadership role in RTX’s enterprise SAP S/4HANA transformation, supporting the modernization and standardization of field service operations across Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon.
  • The role provides the opportunity to lead complex business transformation initiatives involving field service execution, technician scheduling, service order management, and integration with enterprise ERP capabilities. Responsibilities include establishing standardized business processes, defining solution requirements, managing implementation deliverables, and supporting successful deployment across multiple business units.
  • The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Digital Technology, Aftermarket, Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul (MRO), supply chain, finance, operations, and customer service, to ensure Field Service Management capabilities align with enterprise objectives and operational requirements.
  • This position requires the ability to evaluate existing business processes, identify opportunities for standardization, and translate operational requirements into scalable technology solutions. Strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and problem-solving skills will be essential to navigating complex integrations and driving successful business outcomes.
  • The Senior Manager will also have the opportunity to develop team capabilities, influence enterprise process decisions, and provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership while supporting RTX’s long-term digital transformation objectives.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 14 years of prior relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and a minimum of 12 years of experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Field Service Management, Aftermarket operations, service delivery, ERP systems, or related business transformation initiatives, with expertise in leading large-scale ERP implementations and enterprise system integrations.
  • Experience with Field Service Management processes, including service order management, technician scheduling, dispatch, field service execution, and service completion.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with stakeholders such as Digital Technology and business operations, to define requirements, deliver integrated enterprise solutions, and influence senior executives and stakeholders effectively.
  • Experience in conflict resolution, stakeholder management, and performance management.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Proven expertise in implementing SAP S/4HANA Service Management, SAP Field Service Management, or comparable enterprise Field Service Management solutions, with integration capabilities for ERP, CRM, inventory management, and finance systems.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA processes, including service order processing, service contracts, service execution, maintenance, and logistics, combined with familiarity with SAP implementation methodologies such as SAP Activate and Agile delivery.
  • Extensive experience in Aerospace and Defense Aftermarket operations, including field maintenance, technical support, repair services, and customer service delivery, along with field service scheduling, resource optimization, and digital service execution.
  • Demonstrated success in supporting enterprise process harmonization across multiple business units and regions, while leading organizational change management, business readiness, and adoption activities during large-scale technology transformations.
  • Strong understanding of process governance, operational performance metrics, and continuous improvement methodologies, with a proven ability to work with system integrators, technology vendors, and distributed implementation teams.

What We Offer:

Some of our competitive benefits package includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option

Field Pharmacy Account Manager

The Pharmacy Account Manager is responsible for providing support to Premier member hospital and health system pharmacies to implement and optimize use of the Premier GPO pharmacy portfolio. The account manager establishes and maintains strong member relationships that enable rapid dissemination of important information regarding our contract portfolios, educational services, consultative offerings, technology products, and other pharmacy-centric solutions. The account manager provides additional subject matter expertise for field leadership and staff. Specific tasks include but are not limited to the following:

• Serves as the account manager to Premier members and field staff for pharmacy topics,

• Drives cross functional customer support incorporating internal and external solutions to assist members in driving contract penetration, member value and savings,

• Influence purchase decisions with various levels of hospital administration and staff including: pharmacy, supply chain, nursing, physicians, administration, etc.,

• Participate in projects as needed to fully support the specific clinical service line,

• Manage responses for purchase decision support, including line item price validation, comparative quote analyses, and face-to-face and telephone consultation, etc.,

• Create and facilitate member and staff education on product usage and cost efficiencies with various other internal and external subject matter experts,

• Monitor and track the sales cycle (from initial lead to close of sale) of Premier suppliers,

• Provide technical oversight to contracting staff in the development of contract launch and promotional materials, surveys, second sourcing events, product planning initiatives, and category specific committee meetings/presentations,

• Provide timely analyses, reviews contract pricing accuracy, keep data updated, monitor drug product recalls and notify facility pharmacy departments, provide oversight of the FDA’s DSCSA program (i.e. “Track and Trace”),

• Display technical competency working from various data sources, take a request for information and identify the best sources to retrieve the information from,

• Demonstrate a high degree of independence and ownership of projects, and summarize data in visually appealing presentations to influence decision making,

• Facilitate member education using available resources and materials

• Assist with new member implementation, rostering issues and orientation

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1

Relationship Management

• Create and maintain effective communication with all assigned members and health-systems. Provide periodic updates to the member regarding their use of Premier services and opportunities to further that penetration. Participate in additional activities that nurture strong member relationships by answering questions and learning about each assigned member to suggest the portfolio of contracts and services that will establish relevance for Premier in their respective pharmacy program.

• Ultimately, the opportunity to unearth additional services and offerings that expand the member’s involvement with Premier.

Responsibility #2

Knowledge Transfer

Work closely with the membership field services staff assigned to the same members. Provide technical support in answering specific pharmacy questions and follow-up with appropriate materials to ensure the member finds value in their Premier ownership. Expedite the uptake of relevant information and problem resolution.

Responsibility #3

Meeting/Committee Liaison

• Coordinate the content for regional pharmacy meetings as they are scheduled and coordinated by the membership field services staff.

• May have involvement with negotiation of pharmaceutical purchase agreements. May participate in discussions with suppliers regarding the sale and delivery of pharmaceutical spend data.

The Cloud Solution Architect will serve as the technical authority for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations while also driving the functional architecture and solution design for Dynamics 365 Project Operations.

Primary Focus: D365 F&O Technical Architecture (70%) + D365 Project Operations Functional Architecture (30%)


Key Responsibilities:

D365 Finance & Operations – Technical Architecture

Solution Architecture

  • Design and govern enterprise-scale Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations architectures.
  • Define application, integration, security, and infrastructure architectures.
  • Lead technical solution design workshops with stakeholders and engineering teams.
  • Establish architecture standards, development frameworks, and governance processes.

Development & Technical Leadership

  • Provide oversight for X++ customizations and extensions.
  • Design upgrade-safe solutions using Microsoft best practices.
  • Guide development teams through code reviews and technical design reviews.
  • Define deployment strategies across DEV, TEST, UAT, and PROD environments.

Integration Architecture

  • Architect integrations between: D365 F&OAzure Integration ServicesPower Platform
  • Design solutions leveraging: Data Management Framework (DMF)Dual WriteDataverseLogic AppsAPI Management

Functional Solution Design

  • Lead functional design for Dynamics 365 Project Operations.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Project Operations solutions.

Business Process Consulting

  • Facilitate workshops with business stakeholders.
  • Conduct Fit-Gap Analysis.
  • Recommend process improvements and industry best practices.
  • Create functional design documents and solution blueprints.

Resource & Project Management

  • Design solutions supporting: Resource schedulingCapacity planningSkills managementDemand forecastingUtilization tracking

Financial Management

  • Define project costing models.
  • Configure billing methodologies.
  • Design revenue and profitability tracking processes.
  • Support integrated financial reporting across project portfolios.

User Adoption

  • Support organizational change management initiatives.
  • Lead user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Assist training teams and business champions.
  • Ensure successful business adoption of Project Operations capabilities.

Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (Technical)

  • X++ Development

raw.excerpt: We are building somethingEPIC. Evestia Clinical is a biotech-focused global CRO delivering authentic expertise and personalized support where client need it most.
raw.description:
We are building somethingEPIC.

Evestia Clinical is a biotech-focused global CRO delivering authentic expertise and personalized support where client need it most.

Our foundation is built on four core principles: Innovation drives us to seek new solutions, Excellence defines the high standards we keep, and genuine Care ensures a supportive culture for both our patients and our people. We foster Partnership in everything we do, believing that working together—with trust and flexibility—is the key to success.

Our approach is agile by nature and personalized by design. This translates to a workplace where you are empowered to find the creative solutions necessary for our collective success. We offer a welcoming, flexible, and supportive culture that values trust and belonging, ensuring you have the support needed to grow your skills and thrive while making a difference. We partner with our clients to provide expert knowledge and guidance through complex clinical trials in rare disease, oncology, neurology, immunology, and inflammation. At Evestia Clinical, you will become a vital part of a global specialist CRO. This means you will deliver life changing impact through clinical excellence.

We are committed to creating development opportunities that allow your skills to grow right alongside ours. If you are inspired by this collaborative environment and ready to change the lives of patients worldwide, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Pharmacovigilance Physician to provide medical leadership and expert oversight of safety data across investigational and marketed products. In this role, you will be responsible for the medical review and assessment of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), proactive signal detection and evaluation, and the review of periodic aggregate safety reports, including PBRERs and PSURs.

You will also work closely with our Medical Affairs team, providing specialist medical input and supporting the clinical medical monitoring team. This position offers the opportunity to contribute across both pharmacovigilance and broader clinical functions, helping to ensure the ongoing safety and benefit-risk assessment of the products we support.

What will your job look like?

Pharmacovigilance & Safety Operations

  • Perform robust medical review of ICSRs from clinical trials and post-marketing projects, ensuring accurate assessment of seriousness, causality, and expectedness/labeledness.

  • Review and ensure the medical accuracy and appropriateness of MedDRA and WHO Drug coding for adverse events and concomitant medications.

  • Author scientifically valid medical assessments, company comments, and concise medical summaries for complex or serious reported events.

  • Author safety-related queries to investigative sites or reporters to ensure complete and accurate clinical data collection.

  • Review and contribute to cumulative analyses of similar adverse events to support regulatory reporting and safety evaluations, including Analysis of Similar Events (AOSE) where applicable.

  • Provide medical support, guidance, mentoring, and training to the PV team, as required.

  • Review scientific literature to identify potential safety signals or valid ICSRs.

  • Apply sound medical judgment and clinical expertise to provide advice, data interpretations, and strategic guidance to PV and other internal functional departments, clients, and external partners.

  • Provide medical input for responses to regulatory authority requests, inspections, and sponsor audits and safety inquiries

Aggregate Reporting & Signal Management

  • Provide crucial medical input, review, and approval for periodic post-market and clinical safety reports, including PBRERs, PSURs, and DSURs.

  • Participate in active and routine signal detection activities. Evaluate potential safety signals, review safety data trends, and contribute to signal validation and assessment reports.

  • Contribute to integrated benefit-risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle and provide medical interpretation of evolving safety profiles.

  • Participate in or present safety data at internal Safety Management Committees (SMCs) or Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs) or sponsor safety governance meetings as contracted, providing medical interpretation, clinical context, and recommendations to support informed safety decision-making.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and provide medical input for Safety Management Plans (SMPs).

  • Provide flexible, occasional support to the clinical medical monitoring function to ensure project continuity during peak workloads or team absences.

  • When supporting clinical operations, assist in responding to site investigators regarding protocol eligibility, safety concerns, and data management queries.

  • Perform ad-hoc medical review of clinical trial data listings, laboratory reports, and subject profiles to ensure medical accuracy and identify potential safety concerns.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

Ensure all pharmacovigilance and medical monitoring activities comply with applicable global regulations (e.g., ICH-GVP, ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA), SOPs, and client requirements

Education:

  • Primary medical degree (e.g., MD, MBBS, MBChB, DO or equivalent) from an accredited medical school is required.

  • Active or previously held medical license/registration is required.

Experience:

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience as a physician in the pharmaceutical industry or a CRO, with a primary focus on Pharmacovigilance and Drug Safety.

  • Proven, hands-on experience performing medical review of ICSRs.

  • Experience with aggregate safety report (PBRERs, PSURs, DSURs) review and generation is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of global regulations regarding drug safety and pharmacovigilance (ICH, FDA, EMA).

  • Strong scientific, clinical, and analytical knowledge with excellent ability to read, analyze, and interpret scientific data.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific and clinical data.

Competencies & Skills

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with Investigators, clients, and regulatory authorities.

  • Highly proficient in utilizing electronic applications, specifically the ability to efficiently navigate clinical and pharmacovigilance safety databases to conduct medical reviews and extract data.

  • Ability to exercise independent medical judgment and make timely, evidence-based decisions in time-sensitive situations, including complex safety assessments, benefit-risk evaluation, signal management, and clinical trial eligibility support when required.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and with external stakeholders.

  • Strong knowledge of MedDRA and WHO Drug coding dictionaries.

What we offer you in return?

We believe that to do your best work, you need the best support. That's why we care deeply about your wellbeing, personal development, and achieving a true work-life balance.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to influence patient safety on a global scale while working with talented colleagues who share a passion for scientific excellence. We offer a collaborative and flexible working environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to contribute to meaningful work that ultimately benefits patients around the world.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Does joining Evestia Clinical and making a global impact excite you? Then it's time to apply!

We are eager to meet ambitious candidates. Remember, we hire for potential and passion. Therefore if you feel you're a good fit but don't meet every single requirement, please submit your application anyway. We want to hear from you.
