At Stearns Bank, we’re helping people, entrepreneurs, small businesses, and local communities nationwide reach their full financial potential. Sound like something you want to be a part of? If so, we’re currently looking for a Commercial Lender This position is a Connected Mobile Work Environment position.

Come see how we’re doing business unusual and charting our own path to reimagine a more inclusive financial services and banking ecosystem for all.

BENEFITS

Stearns Bank understands and respects that everyone is managing unique career, family, and wellness needs. That’s why we offer industry-leading benefits to employees to help them live healthy lives and bring their full selves to work every day. Benefits may vary for part-time positions. Some of those benefits include:

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan & 401k Plan
  • Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision, Telehealth, Life insurance)
  • 12-week Paid Parental Leave and Medical Leave: With a cap of 20 weeks for eligible team members who qualify for both Medical and Parental Leave related to the birth of a child
  • $5,000 Family Care Reimbursement: Childcare, Elder Care, Student Loan Debt, Pet expenses, Down Payment Assistance, Health Insurance Premiums
  • PTO from 13 to 23 days depending on tenure. Cashout and Carryover options
  • 10 Days Sick Time
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • 4 Days Volunteer Time
  • 2 Days Self Allowance Time
  • Tuition Assistance

For this position, we anticipate an annual salary between $140,000 – 175,000 Final employment offers will be dependent upon the selected candidate’s relevant qualifications and experience.

JOB SUMMARY

Develop and manage lending relationships for the purpose of generating loan requests that meet established lending requirements, which provide maximum profitability to the bank with a minimum risk. Including managing a loan portfolio for the express purpose of increasing balances and profit, and decreasing past dues, charge-offs, and other loan problems. Ability to work within the bank’s national lending platform under various programs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop an on-going personal business development plan that utilizes a structured calling program that generates an agreed-to minimum of new loan growth and fee generation based on business unit KPIs.
  • Collect necessary information from loan applicants so that loan requests can be understood and properly underwritten; respond to the credit department’s questions pertaining to the underwriting process to determine the credit worthiness of loan applicants.
  • Will provide information as requested on status of loans in process and approved but not closed (pipeline and backlog report).
  • Make timely decisions on loan applications within granted authorities.
  • Is responsible for the accuracy of loan grading, documentation, performance, clearing of exceptions, and follow-up on all loans in assigned portfolio.
  • Will actively work existing customer base for referrals that garners new business from prospects and existing customers alike.
  • Maintain a list of delinquent accounts within the personal portfolio and maintain a log of collection efforts. Contact delinquent accounts via telephone, personal visits or correspondence. Forward irreconcilable accounts for collector action or pursuing legal action.
  • Monitor loan repayment for loans in assigned portfolio and take necessary action to collect past due loans.
  • Participate in community activities for the purpose of increasing the bank’s visibility and seeking out new business opportunities.
  • Promote bank services, seek out referral opportunities (including consumer loans), answer customer questions, and direct customers to the appropriate personnel for assistance.
  • Effectively use bank systems and other technology to the fullest extent of their capabilities to include lead tracking, opportunities, file notes, underwriting, processing, closings, and servicing workflows.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of all legal and regulatory compliance issues as they pertain to this position.
  • Loss prevention and security as applicable to this position.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 lbs.
  • Ability to understand and follow instructions in English.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods of time, twist, bend, sit, walk use hands to twist, handle or feel objects, tools or controls, such as computer mouse, computer keyboard, calculator, stapler, telephone, staple puller, etc., reach with hands and arms, balance, stoop, kneel, talk or hear.
  • Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university preferred but will consider experience in lieu of degree.
  • Proven track record in commercial lending, specifically for commercial and commercial real estate loan requests.
  • Relationship management skills for commercial, small business, and personal relationships.
  • Highly developed analytical and underwriting expertise and a credit quality focus.
  • Portfolio management experience required.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Proficient computer skills.
  • Excellent customer service skills.

THE COMPANY

Founded in 1912, Stearns Financial Services Inc. (SFSI) is a $3.2 billion, independently owned financial institution with locations in Minnesota, Florida and Arizona, and over 35,000 small business customers nationwide. Specializing in affordable housing financing, USDA and SBA lending, and small business and equipment financing, Stearns Bank is regularly recognized as one of the country’s top-performing banks and “Best Banks to Work For” by American Banker.

As a Star Tribune Top Workplaces award recipient and an award recipient of the Minnesota Business Magazine 100 Best Places to Work in Minnesota, Stearns takes pride in their team and holds their employees in extremely high regard. Leadership

  • Lead the global direct sales organization to expand the existing customer base, acquire new direct customers, and deliver clear, measurable annual, quarterly, and monthly targets.

Backed by leading technology investors Vista Equity Partners and Insight Partners, Portside is entering an exciting phase of growth. We are expanding our platform, investing in AI driven innovation, and building a global team focused on shaping the future of aviation technology.

Job Summary

Portside is seeking a Strategic Sales Executive to drive growth across a portfolio of key aviation customers and prospects. This role is responsible for developing executive relationships, identifying expansion opportunities, and positioning Portside as a long-term technology partner across multiple aviation segments, including charter, fractional, corporate flight departments, regional airlines, emergency services, and government operators.

The ideal candidate has a consultative, enterprise-sales mindset and a proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. This role will focus on expanding customer relationships, increasing platform adoption, and driving recurring revenue growth through strategic account planning and solution-based selling.

This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts across charter, fractional, corporate, regional airline, emergency services, and government aviation segments.
  • Develop and execute account strategies that drive adoption of the broader Portside platform through cross-sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities.
  • Position Portside as a strategic technology partner by aligning solutions to customers' operational, financial, and commercial objectives.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, operations teams, finance organizations, maintenance leaders, flight departments, and IT teams.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from opportunity identification through negotiation, contracting, and successful handoff to implementation and customer success teams.
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Leadership teams to maximize customer value and long-term account growth.
  • Identify opportunities created by mergers, acquisitions, fleet growth, operational changes, and evolving regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of aviation market trends, customer challenges, competitive dynamics, and emerging technology solutions.
  • Deliver accurate forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and territory management while consistently achieving revenue objectives.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by providing market intelligence, competitive insights, and product feedback to support Portside's product and go-to-market strategies.
  • Leverage CRM, sales intelligence, and AI-assisted tools to improve account planning, prospecting, forecasting, and customer engagement.
  • Represent Portside at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings to strengthen relationships and expand market presence.

Qualifications

Position Purpose: Leads Centene's vendor AI review and integration standards function, accountable for ensuring that third-party and vendor-supplied AI capability entering the enterprise is properly assessed, architecturally suitable for Centene's AI Control Plane, and held to defined integration and interoperability standards over the life of the relationship. Directs vendor AI intake review and technical assessment in coordination with AI Intake, Enterprise AI Governance, Security Risk Management/TPRM, Procurement, and Legal, ensuring AI functionality is disclosed, evaluated, and routed through the required review paths before contract execution or deployment. Determines and documents each vendor solution's suitability to the AI Control Plane across the defined integration points — intake assessment, control adherence, vendor agents running on Centene's agentic framework, vendor agents interacting with LLMs through the Centene AI Gateway, and network-level AI observability. Ensures compliance with Centene's standards for vendor AI integration, including open-standard and protocol expectations such as MCP, model routing and gateway use, telemetry and observability schemas, agent registration, and cost attribution. Owns ongoing vendor AI control plane adherence — monitoring conformance, managing model-change notification, and driving remediation when vendor solutions drift from approved patterns. Leads a team and serves as the enterprise's AI voice in vendor AI evaluations, bake-offs, relationship management, and contract negotiations.


Key Details: Centene is going through our biggest transformation in our history to become the market leader, and AI is the key tool to enable the transformation. This is an exciting opportunity to use AI to transform a Fortune 20 company, and to change healthcare for the better! This is a remote role within the United States, requiring business travel 2-3 times per quarter. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.


  • Provides leadership and management oversight for vendor AI assessment, integration architecture, and standards conformance across the enterprise AI portfolio. Defines the evaluation methodology and standards, leads the team performing assessments, partners across governance and risk functions, and is accountable for the technical suitability, interoperability, and ongoing control adherence of vendor-supplied AI at Centene.
  • Leads intake review and assessment of vendor AI solutions, including new vendor AI, AI functionality being activated within existing vendor platforms, and scope changes to current vendor offerings — coordinating with AI Intake and Security Risk Management so the third-party intake and vendor risk assessment are engaged at the right point.
  • Administers the vendor AI due diligence process, including the Vendor AI Questionnaires covering model identification, agentic behavior, AI lifecycle governance, testing and evaluation for accuracy and bias, data use and training, lineage, orchestration and data flow, retention, subprocessor chains, PHI/PII handling, MCP server inventory, and incident response.
  • Determines and documents each vendor solution's suitability to Centene's AI Control Plane, selecting and validating the applicable integration pattern — agents on Centene's agentic framework, vendor-hosted agents routing model calls through the Centene AI Gateway, network-level observability, or a combination — and identifying gaps requiring remediation or exception.
  • Assures compliance with Centene's vendor AI integration and interoperability standards, including open-standard and protocol expectations (MCP, open APIs), model routing, prompt and agent versioning and change approval, telemetry and trace schemas, and cost attribution and budget controls.
  • Establishes the evaluation framework used in vendor AI bake-offs and competitive assessments, including scoring criteria, reference architecture fit, evidence quality expectations, and documented recommendations to business and technology sponsors.
  • Conducts documentation review for vendor AI, assessing architecture, security, data flow, AI governance, and operational support materials for evidence-based claims, disclosed limitations, and explainability rather than marketing assertions.
  • Partners with Procurement and Legal to define AI-specific contractual requirements, including AI governance and risk management clauses, incident response and SLA expectations, audit rights, restrictions on training against Centene data and context, and mandatory model-change notification.
  • Owns ongoing vendor AI control plane adherence, including periodic conformance review, processing of vendor model and capability change notifications, re-assessment triggers when scope changes, and escalation and remediation when a vendor solution falls outside approved patterns.
  • Ensures vendor AI systems and vendor-supplied agents are registered in the enterprise AI Inventory and Agent Registry with required metadata, risk tier, ownership, and lifecycle state, and that control evidence is available to support regulator, market conduct, and contractual evidence requests.
  • Serves as the designated technical reviewer and escalation point for AI functionality identified during third-party intake, reducing returned intakes caused by undisclosed AI capability.
  • Maintains and publishes vendor AI standards, reference integration patterns, required evidence lists, and routing guidance so business sponsors and vendors understand expectations before engagement begins.
  • Recruits, develops, and leads a team of staff performing vendor AI assessment and integration design; sets technical standards and quality expectations for assessment work products.
  • Partners across AI Enablement, Enterprise AI Governance, Security, Data & AI platform teams, Procurement, Legal, and business sponsors, representing Centene's technical position in vendor discussions and negotiations.
  • Partners across AI Enablement, Enterprise AI Governance, Security, Data & AI platform teams, Procurement, Legal, and business sponsors, representing Centene's technical position in vendor discussions and negotiations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:

  • Requires a Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of related experience, including prior management experience.
  • Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Preferred:

  • Experience vetting and implementing vendor solutions, preferably AI solutions.

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Job Title: Chief Transformation Officer (CTO)

Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer leads enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, driving large-scale change across strategy, operations, technology, and culture. This role is accountable for delivering measurable business outcomes through transformation programs, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and sustainable value creation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transformation Strategy & Execution

Define and execute enterprise transformation strategy aligned with business goals

Lead large-scale change programs (digital, operational, organizational)

Translate strategy into actionable transformation roadmaps and milestones

2. Program Leadership & Governance

Establish governance frameworks for transformation initiatives

Oversee program management, timelines, budgets, and delivery outcomes

Ensure cross-functional alignment and accountability

3. Operational Excellence & Process Optimization

Drive process reengineering, efficiency improvements, and cost optimization

Implement lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies

Enhance productivity and operational performance

4. Digital & Technology Transformation

Partner with CIO, CTO (Engineering), and CDO (Digital/Data) to enable transformation

Drive adoption of digital platforms, automation, and emerging technologies

Ensure integration of technology into business processes

5. Change Management & Culture

Lead organizational change management initiatives

Build a culture of agility, innovation, and continuous improvement

Manage stakeholder engagement and communication at all levels

6. Performance & Value Realization

Define KPIs and success metrics for transformation initiatives

Track and report ROI, benefits realization, and business impact

Ensure sustainability of transformation outcomes

7. Stakeholder & Executive Alignment

Work closely with CEO, Board, and executive leadership

Align transformation initiatives with corporate strategy

Influence decision-making and secure buy-in across the organization

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or related field (MBA preferred)

15–20+ years of experience in transformation, consulting, operations, or strategy roles

Proven track record of leading large-scale transformation programs

Experience in digital transformation, process optimization, and change management

Background in consulting (e.g., Big 4, strategy firms) is often preferred

Key Competencies

Strategic thinking and execution excellence

Strong program and change management skills

Data-driven decision-making

Greensboro Radiology is a premier, highly subspecialized private practice with 55+ radiologists serving multiple health systems and imaging centers throughout central North Carolina. Our mission is to lead radiology excellence through personalized, compassionate care.

Greensboro is a vibrant, welcoming city that blends urban amenities with Southern charm. As North Carolina’s third-largest city, it offers:

  • Affordable living and excellent schools

Cone Memorial Hospital, a 500+ bed, full-service tertiary care center serving the greater Greensboro region, which is a Level II Trauma Center with a certified stroke center; Wesley Long Hospital, a 175-bed hospital providing comprehensive medical and surgical services; Alamance Regional Medical Center, a 200+ bed community hospital serving Burlington and the surrounding areas and a designated stroke center; and Annie Penn Hospital.
The practice also supports several outpatient imaging and procedural clinics throughout the market, providing convenient access to care across the region.
These hospitals are recognized for clinical excellence, advanced technology, and continued growth to meet the needs of a thriving and expanding community. *This role is open to remote based candidates based in Canada, with a preference for PST/EST

We’re looking for an Account Executiveto join our Parks and Recreation team. Parks and rec departments run some of the most-used services in a community, from programs and camps to facilities and memberships, and many still rely on dated systems. You will help cities, towns, and counties move to Traction Rec, the recreation management platform built on Salesforce. You will own the full sales cycle, from first conversation through RFP, contract and handoff, and spend most of your day in consultative conversations with recreation leaders, finance teams, and IT as a trusted advisor, helping them build a confident case for change with their councils and communities.

Who we are

At Traction Rec, community is at the heart of everything we do. We empower nonprofit organizations like YMCAs, Jewish Community Centers (JCCs), and Boys & Girls Clubs of America (BGCA) to strengthen their communities through great technology built on the Salesforce platform. By enabling these organizations to deliver their services more efficiently, we help them focus on creating meaningful connections and driving positive change where it matters most.

We believe that business is a powerful force for good. As part of this belief, we’ve committed to the Pledge 1% for the Planet, dedicating 1% of our time, product, profit, or equity to supporting environmental and community causes. This commitment reflects our dedication to creating a positive impact that extends beyond technology.

Our passion for community and innovation has earned us recognition, including:

  • Salesforce Nonprofit Sales Partner of the Year and ISV Partner of the Year
  • Globe & Mail's Top Growing Companies of 2024
  • Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 winner
  • Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 winner

At Traction Rec, we live our values: Community, Authenticity, Impact, Fun, and Growth. As a Living Wage Certified employer in British Columbia, we are dedicated to supporting not just the communities we serve but also the people who make it all happen—our team.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to join a company that puts community first, we’d love to have you on this journey with us. Together, let’s create stronger, healthier, and more connected communities.

Skills

Traction Rec’rs come from a variety of backgrounds, and we are eager to find people that are from diverse backgrounds. For this role, you might have :

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years in client facing B2B sales (SaaS specific experience a benefit)
  • Experience selling to public sector, government, or municipal buyers (parks and recreation experience is a strong asset)
  • Comfort with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and formal procurement, including RFPs and council approvals
  • A track record of successful quota achievement and successful in net new customer acquisition
  • Ability to build relationships with client leadership and establish trusted advisor status through strong business acumen
  • A passion for working with municipalities and community organizations
  • Experience or strong interest in business application or CRM technology
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, including RFP responses and executive summaries
  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Entrepreneurial mindset demonstrating collaboration and excitement to build a business
  • Proven proficiency in account/territory planning and account engagement strategies
  • Implementation of sales strategies and methodologies (such as MEDDIC)
  • Demonstrate success in fast-paced, collaborative team selling environments
  • Bonus points if you’ve spent time in local government, parks and recreation, community centers or the Salesforce ecosystem

What You Will Be Doing

  • Territory planning and prospect activities
  • Lead generation at target accounts and key stakeholder engagement
  • Promote and attend municipal and recreation industry events
  • Sales discovery and qualification using established sales methodology
  • Navigate public sector buying processes, including RFPs, procurement rules, council and committee approvals, and budget cycle
  • Drive sales strategy plans and execution to consistently achieve or exceed sales revenue and activity goals
  • Identification of organization pain points and objectives while aligning to Traction Rec solutions
  • Relationship management with multiple stakeholders at various levels, including recreation directors, program managers, finance, IT, and procurement
  • Client presentations (remote and onsite) to large and small audiences
  • Management of contracting, negotiation, objection handling, and client procurement processes
  • On-going account management and advocacy for client success
  • Building brand awareness in the municipal parks and recreation markets
  • Working alongside key external partners while executing joint strategies
  • Seek growth opportunities and new business value to maximize sales
  • Coordination between clients, partners, and internal team members aligning stakeholders for mutual success
  • Working hands on with internal business applications for collaboration
  • Keep Salesforce current for accurate pipeline management and forecasting
  • Travel expected roughly every other month

Compensation

At Traction Rec, we are committed to a fair, market-based and equitable compensation structure. Our market data is refreshed on an annual basis to reflect the most current market conditions.

The base salary for this role is $85,000 with on target earnings (OTE) of $145,000, which includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary.

Please note that the range details above does not include our competitive benefits that we offer.

If you’re interested, so are we! Send your resume our way, and let’s chat.

At Traction Rec, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve, and we actively seek and welcome candidates from all backgrounds. Our hiring process is designed to be fair, welcoming, and respectful to all candidates, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, ability, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity brings unique perspectives and experiences that can enhance our team and drive innovation, and we are committed to providing equal opportunity and support to all candidates. We encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to the interview process and join us in building a diverse and inclusive culture at Traction Rec.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Architect & Build Agentic Systems: Design and develop end-to-end multi-agent systems from scratch. You will create the foundational agent harnesses, define communication protocols, and build orchestration layers using frameworks like CrewAI, Langgraph, and AutoGen. Architectural decisions to ensure:

    • Hierarchical and collaborative multi-agent structures with well-defined agent roles, responsibilities, and communication protocols

    • Dynamic task decomposition, sophisticated tool integration, planning mechanisms (ReAct), and self-correction loops

    • Develop state management systems and memory mechanisms for persistent agent interactions

  • Engineer Advanced Agent Capabilities: Develop custom agent-tools and define specialized agent-skills that empower agents to perform complex, domain-specific tasks.

  • Pioneer Context Engineering: Implement advanced context engineering and memory systems to ensure agents maintain state, learn from interactions, and make informed decisions in dynamic environments.

You will implement best-in-class MLOps practices for monitoring, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and system reliability.

  • Integrate and Optimize LLMs: Integrate LLMs to serve as the core reasoning engines for autonomous agents. You will apply advanced techniques like RAG and PEFT to optimize performance.

  • Create and maintain comprehensive tool libraries for agents including API integrations, database queries, and external service connections

  • Design and implement RAG systems using vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB)

  • Develop custom tools and plugins that enable agents to interact with various enterprise systems and APIs

  • Ensure tool reliability, error handling, and seamless integration within agentic workflows

  • Implement comprehensive monitoring and tracing systems for agent behavior, performance, cost optimization, and latency analysis

  • Design novel evaluation frameworks to assess multi-step agentic task success, reliability, and accuracy

  • Utilize advanced observability tools (LangSmith, Arize AI, or custom solutions) to trace agent decision making processes

  • Establish metrics and KPIs for measuring agentic system performance in production environments

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Experience:

  • 6-8 years of hands on experience in machine learning and AI engineering with proven track record of taking ML systems to production

  • Demonstrated expertise in building multi-agent systems and agentic workflows, preferably with Langraph/CrewAI

Technical Skills - Must Have:

  • Programming & ML: Expert-level Python proficiency with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers). Experience with FastAPI, async programming, and microservices architecture

  • Data & Vector Systems: Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB) and building scalable RAG systems

  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with LLM application monitoring tools (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, custom telemetry solutions)

  • Proven ability to architect and implement complex AI systems from scratch in production environments

  • Cloud Platform Expertise: Production-level experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including:

    • Compute services (EC2, GCE, Azure VMs)

    • Serverless functions (Lambda, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)

    • Container orchestration (EKS, GKE, AKS)

    • Managed AI/ML services (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML)

  • Production & DevOps: Strong skills in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

Technical Skills - Good to have:

  • Experience with prompt engineering techniques, fine-tuning SLMs (PEFT, SFT, RLHF), and model optimization

  • Knowledge of distributed systems, message queues, and event-driven architectures for agent coordination

  • Familiarity with SDLC best practices, version control (Git), and agile development methodologies

  • Experience with tool-calling agents, multi-step workflows, and stateful orchestration (e.g. graphs, planners, routers).

  • Hands-on evals for agents: trajectory / tool-use checks, golden traces, LLM-as-judge with fixed rubrics, regression suites.

  • Online evals, drift thinking, and clear quality gates before or after deploy (thresholds, alerts, rollback criteria).

  • Safety and abuse: prompt injection via tools, untrusted retrieval, PII handling in prompts and logs, allowlists and guardrails.

  • Cost and latency discipline: budgets per run, timeouts, caps on turns and tool calls.

  • Model lifecycle: routing / gateway patterns, version pinning, fallbacks, and which model for which step.

  • Memory and state: what is persisted, retention, redaction, and what must never be stored

Soft Skills:

  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical thinking with ability to tackle complex, ambiguous challenges

  • Strong communication skills to explain complex agentic concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Proven ability to work independently and drive large-scale projects to completion with minimal supervision

What’s in it for YOU at Quantiphi:

The National Conference of Bar Examiners (NCBE) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing a competent, ethical, and diverse legal profession. We develop and deliver high-quality assessment products, services, and research that support state courts and licensing authorities in evaluating the readiness of aspiring lawyers.

NCBE is committed to fostering a collaborative, mission-driven environment with competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, flexible scheduling, and professional development opportunities. NCBE’s headquarters is based in Madison, Wisconsin, a dynamic community with exceptional amenities.

The Associate Director of Assessment Development oversees the creation of content and the construction of assessment forms for one or more of NCBE’s assessment programs, with a main focus on the Multistate Professional Responsibility Examination. The associate director may manage staff editors who work with subject matter experts to draft items, select items for use on assessment forms, and create other related materials, including for grading, study aids and licensing, marketing, and training. This person works closely with the Director of Assessment Development and the psychometric team to ensure that the items and assessments achieve appropriate levels of quality in terms of fairness, reliability, and validity. The associate director also works closely with many departments including operations (printing, publishing, accessibility, and administration), IT (item banking, delivery), and psychometrics (design, scoring, analysis and reporting). This role serves as a key resource on content matters to NCBE stakeholders, both internally and externally, on the program. The associate director is specialized in a measurement component (e.g., selected response doctrinal measurement, performance assessments, integrated assessments) aligned with the program they oversee.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Works with psychometric staff to ensure that NCBE’s assessments are in compliance with professional standards for educational testing.
  • Oversees development of assessment content including items, forms, grading material, study aids, technical documentation, and other materials.
  • Advises on measurement specialization across programs and contributes expertise as required.
  • Assists with recruitment of subject matter experts and ensures appropriate training, including for drafting and review committees.
  • Collaborates with the operations team on the development of production schedules, implementation of security procedures for assessment materials, and appropriate staff/resource allocation to ensure efficient, high-quality services, problem resolution, and on-time delivery of materials.
  • Ensures adherence to existing NCBE policies and procedures, updates as needed, and manages policies and procedures that meet the highest standards of quality, security, accuracy, and efficiency for content development and construction of assessments.
  • Encourages process improvement by staff and promotes a mindset that fosters continuous quality improvement.
  • Participates in research and contributes to the design and development of new NCBE programs, processes, products, or services.
  • Assists with inquiries or complaints regarding assessment content.
  • May manage staff in the day-to-day performance of their jobs.
  • Develops and provides presentations for meetings, conferences, workshops, and seminars.
  • Travel to committee meetings or conferences is expected.

Qualifications:

  • Graduate of an ABA-approved law school and admitted to the bar in at least one jurisdiction.
  • At least 10 years of significant professional legal experience with a demonstrated knowledge of professional responsibility law and a willingness to develop additional expertise in the relevant subject-matter.
  • Ability to develop working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including subject matter experts.
  • Proficiency in MS Word and Excel.
  • High level of organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to travel to meetings across the U.S. and Canada.
  • This position is typically promoted from within the organization; managerial experience in test development is preferred.

The Associate Director of Assessment Development may work remotely. NCBE will consider applicants from the following states: FL, IA, IN, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NE, NJ, NM, NV, OK, PA, WA, and WI.

This position may include up to 10% travel for meetings with committees and/or vendors, and/or for conferences, workshops, and/or outreach. 

Mission

NCBE promotes fairness, integrity, and best practices in admission to the legal profession for the benefit and protection of the public. We serve admission authorities, courts, the legal education community, and candidates by providing high-quality

  • assessment products, services, and research;
  • character investigations; and
  • informational and educational resources and programs.

EEO Statement

NCBE is proud to be an equal employment opportunity organization. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees regardless of their race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, military service, protected veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadLoomwork, an AI automation venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Loomworkis an AI automation agency for growing companies. Every growing company knows AI is its next growth lever, but few have the people to turn it into working systems. Implementation is the scarce resource.Loomworkhelps them find where AI will pay off, builds agents into the tools they already use, and keeps those agents running. It launches as a services business with a dedicated technical delivery team from day one. Every engagement also serves as research: as client work converges on one segment, Loomwork turns its library of deployed agents into a connected product and grows from agency to software company.

Market Context

The global AI consulting services market is valued at $11.9B in 2026 and is projected to reach $73.9B by 2034, growing at a 25.6% CAGR. North America holds about 38% of the market. Enterprise AI adoption climbed from 20% in 2017 to 88% in 2025, and adoption is outpacing the talent available to deploy it. Roughly 190,000 US and Canadian companies fall in the $10M to $300M revenue range, which puts the serviceable market at an estimated $3B a year. Most of these companies are too large for freelancers and too small for enterprise firms.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across the industry and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the direction of the venture and lead its execution.

  • Strategy: Shape the service offering, pricing, and positioning, and choose the segment to specialize in based on where demand converges

  • Customer Development: Win engagements with growing companies, move clients from assessment to build to retainer, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product: Partner with the FutureSight delivery and engineering team to turn repeated client builds into reusable agents and, ultimately, a connected product

  • Capital: Lead future fundraising, supported by FutureSight's network and the agency's traction

  • Team: Recruit and lead the founding team, including a technical leader as the product takes shape, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to AI implementation, consulting, or selling technology services into growing companies

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Job Title:Machinery Specialist

Status:Contract/Hourly

Becht is a 4.9 STAR Glassdoor company & certified Great Place to Work!

Are you a seasoned Machinery Specialist with deep hands-on experience in rotating equipment maintenance, turnaround surveillance, and shop-quality oversight?

Becht’s Machinery & Reliability Services team supports clients with world-class expertise across the full lifecycle of machinery maintenance, turnaround execution, field troubleshooting, and equipment reliability improvement. Our advisors bring decades of practical, shop-floor, and field experience, enabling high-value guidance that blends technical rigor with real-world judgment. Becht’s reputation is built on delivering trusted expertise that helps our clients execute safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

We are seeking contract Machinery Specialists (Advisors) to support our expanding portfolio of turnaround, maintenance, and machinery oversight engagements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on professional with substantial rotating equipment craft, shop, or inspection experience — someone who has been the “go-to” resource for troubleshooting, failure investigations, job-site quality assurance, and contractor guidance.

Location

Remote with some travel for turnaround assignments, shop inspections, field surveillance, and other client needs (typically U.S.-based).

Schedule

This is a contract position. Work hours will vary depending on project workload, turnaround schedules, shop repair needs, and client requirements.

Responsibilities

Support and Oversee Machinery Maintenance & Turnaround Activities

Work with client teams, planners, shops, vendors, and contractors to ensure rotating equipment is maintained, repaired, and returned to service safely, correctly, and on schedule. Key activities include:

  • Auditing major and minor maintenance plans and verifying readiness for execution.
  • Overseeing disassembly, inspection, repair, reassembly, and alignment of pumps, steam turbines, compressors (centrifugal, reciprocating, rotary), gearboxes, and other critical rotating assets — both in the field and in the shop.
  • Providing QA/QC oversight of repair shops, confirming workmanship, documentation, tolerances, component condition, and compliance with API and OEM requirements.
  • Monitoring progression during turnarounds, reporting status, identifying schedule risks, and advising on scope changes or repair strategy adjustments.
  • Performing field inspections, installation checks, preservation verification, and equipment condition assessments.
  • Supporting machinery start-ups by observing vibration, temperature, seal systems, and operational stabilization.
  • Conducting or contributing to root-cause failure analysis and recommending corrective actions to improve reliability and MTBF.
  • Identifying equipment bad actors and supporting improvements in lubrication, alignment, vibration programs, and operator surveillance rounds.
  • Coordinating with planners, engineers, vendors, and contractors to align expectations on scope, sequencing, repair methods, and documentation.
  • Preparing or reviewing scopes of work, quality plans, inspection test plans, and repair documentation packages in accordance with Becht standards.

Client Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong working relationships with client maintenance, reliability, and turnaround teams. Provide consistent, practical, field-ready guidance while understanding each client’s unique requirements, expectations, and operating environments.

Business Development

In collaboration with Becht leadership, contribute to the growth of machinery and turnaround support services by:

  • Leveraging industry experience, relationships, and reputation to identify opportunities where Becht’s machinery expertise provides value.
  • Supporting proposals, turnaround readiness reviews, or client discussions related to rotating equipment.
  • Helping identify broader needs in maintenance, reliability, and turnaround execution where Becht can further support client success.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in rotating equipment maintenance, shop repair, turnaround execution, or related industrial machinery roles.
  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise with pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and other critical rotating assets.
  • Strong QA/QC and inspection background, with practical knowledge of API standards and OEM requirements.
  • Experience providing field oversight, troubleshooting, contractor supervision, or shop-quality management.
  • Ability to work in dynamic industrial environments with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

Job Description:

POSITION SUMMARY

TransMedics was founded to address the unmet need for more and better organs for transplantation. The Donor Assessment Coordinator is part of TransMedics' NOP program and plays a critical role in donor offer screening, clinical evaluation, communication, and coordination with TransMedics partners, resulting in better utilization of donor organs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Screen organ offers from the OPTN contractor in accordance with Transplant Center protocols and workflows.
  • Effectively communicate with Transplant Center teams, OPO staff, recipients, operating room (OR) teams, and internal TransMedics teams.
  • Maintain knowledge of, understand, and adhere to OPTN policies.
  • Ensure seamless coordination of donor assessment from clinical review through surgeon and recipient communication to transplantation.
  • Collaborate with the TransMedics Logistics team.
  • Consult with TransMedics Clinical Leadership as appropriate.
  • Complete accurate pre- and post-transplant documentation in the Transplant Center EMR and OPTN systems.
  • Participate in a minimum of eight 24-hour on-call shifts per month (including holidays and weekends), based on staffing and business needs.
  • Schedule time off with appropriate advance notice in coordination with the manager.
  • Demonstrate excellent customer service, multitasking, and communication skills.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and team projects as assigned.
  • Attend team meetings outside of scheduled call hours as necessary.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no direct reports.

PHYSICAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Ability to maintain focus and effectively manage time in a high-pressure environment.
  • Must be highly flexible and willing to work within a 24x7 operational environment, including an inconsistent schedule spanning all shifts, weekends, holidays, and on-call coverage.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing, Health Science, Biological Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of three years of experience as a Transplant Coordinator, Organ Procurement Coordinator, or similar role with a strong clinical background in transplantation and in-depth knowledge of human anatomy and physiology.​

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Five or more years of experience as a Transplant Coordinator, Organ Procurement Coordinator, or in a similar transplant-related clinical role.
  • Experience working with multiple organ transplant programs or high-volume transplant centers.
  • Advanced knowledge of OPTN policies, transplant operations, and organ allocation processes.
  • Experience participating in quality improvement initiatives or process improvement within a transplant program.
  • Ability to work effectively with all members of interdisciplinary transplant teams.
  • Working knowledge of transplant logistics and vendor management.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional while working under pressure.
  • Ability and confidence to make independent decisions regarding donor medical management, logistical arrangements, and organ allocation.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple dynamic priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with medical compliance and clinical data sharing.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, and Outlook) and electronic medical record systems.

​

Every Organ Wasted is a Life Not Saved.
TransMedics, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical technology company transforming organ transplant therapy for patients worldwide. Our mission is to help save more patients’ lives by increasing access to viable donor organs for those who are awaiting an organ transplant. To accomplish this mission, we partner closely with transplant stakeholders worldwide and help expand their access to healthy donor organs, while delivering the highest quality technology, service, clinical care and outcomes. 

Driven by a passion for improving patient care, we make the impossible possible and keep our employees at the center of everything we do. Together, we strive to enhance the quality of life for transplant recipients and their families, fostering hope and healing in the journey toward better health. 

Maximize your potential at TransMedics, Inc.

TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation. The expected base salary range for this role is $83,700 -$107,400 which represents the company’s current good-faith estimate of compensation for this position. Actual salary will depend on factors such as, but not limited to, candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific work location. This role may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and wellness resources). raw.title: Principal Platform Engineer, DevOps and Deployment (Regulated AI Software)
raw.excerpt: ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite.
raw.description:
ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite. We combine mechanistic modeling, Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), with software and training to support Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Next-Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA) for pharmaceutical, chemical, and academic partners worldwide. Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.

We are building a platform where AI agents help scientists set up regulated modeling analyses, and fixed, versioned procedures run them. This job is about the engine room: the compute core, the release pipeline and the operations.

About the role

You make sure our analyses can be reproduced, shipped to clients and checked later. You own the compute core, the release pipeline, deployment into client environments, and the metering and provenance behind every result. The AI layer has its own lead and team; you build what they run on. The Quality Manager sets the standards, you implement them. You report to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make the scientific compute core deterministic: pinned R, Python and solver toolchains, content-addressed container images with a software bill of materials, and tests that prove byte-identical re-execution on a reference platform and tolerance-bounded re-execution across platforms.

  • Build the services the AI layer runs on: isolated executors per client without network access, usage metering per call, the signed record and the certificate behind every result. You build the policy engine and the tool router together with the AI lead.

  • Expose the platform as a versioned API and as tools for AI agents with one shared contract, and ship the reproducibility package that re-executes a run outside the platform.

  • Run the evaluation pipeline in continuous integration: conformance tests against reference case sets, re-execution tests, regression tests, results stored per procedure version.

  • Own release engineering and operations: CI/CD pipelines, signed and content-addressed releases, scripted installation qualification, environment management (hosted, in a client tenant, later offline), monitoring, incident handling and the operating model the deployment engineer runs.

  • Implement the technical controls behind the information security and AI management standards the Quality Manager owns.


What you bring

  • At least five years of platform, infrastructure or backend engineering with senior ownership of a production system.

  • Reproducible builds and execution in practice: dependency pinning, artifact hashing, immutable versioning, supply chain integrity. Hermetic build systems are a strong plus.

  • Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator, monitoring, and release management for environments you don’t fully control.

  • API design where the schema was a contract with external consumers, including versioning and deprecation in practice.

  • Security engineering for multi-tenant systems: isolation, secrets, authorization, and awareness of the risks of language-model-driven systems. Exposure to GxP or equivalent regulated software is valuable; interest in acquiring it is required.

What's in store for you

The dynamic team behind ESQlabs unites people with different backgrounds, spanning disciplines like pharmaceutical sciences, physics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science, and software engineering. Our trust in each other, our open-mindedness, and our constant quest for excellence and innovation unite us. We value flat hierarchies, where everyone can contribute ideas and expertise to develop the best product. We are passionate, always willing to broaden our horizons, and love our start-up culture.

You will also benefit from:

  • Flexible work hours and a home office policy that focuses on people and not on numbers

  • An attractive remuneration package

  • Regular in-person team gatherings at locations across Europe.

  • A clearly defined technical problem with a commercial consequence, and the authority to solve it properly rather than quickly.

  • A working environment in which your contribution will make a difference, and that allows you to take ownership of projects and processes

  • A small, senior team that owns an open-source platform used by regulators and pharma, and the mandate to set the standard for certified scientific software.

  • Responsibility, autonomy, participation, and career perspective

About us

We collaborate with global corporations in the pharma and chemical industry, as well as start-ups in the life-science technology sector and academic and non-profit research institutions. We define new standards in pharmacometrics and systems pharmacology and toxicology areas. Our software and model platforms help scientists understand mechanisms of diseases and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized treatment of patients and protect the health of the animal and human life.

ESQlabs has attracted international players as sponsors for the OSP Software development. In addition, funding through national and EU-wide research grants allows us to develop our core technologies continuously.

For more information about our culture, values and benefits visit our Unique career opportunities - esqLABS GmbH.

ESQlabs is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, and value the diversity of perspectives this brings to our team.

raw.title: Splunk Implementation Engineer
raw.excerpt: Position Overview:Our client is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Splunk Certified Implementation Engineer to join their team.
raw.description:
Position Overview:

Our client is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Splunk Certified Implementation Engineer to join their team. A Splunk implementation engineer sets up, configures, and integrates Splunk software so organizations can collect, monitor, and analyze their machine and security data effectively.

Key responsibilities:

Splunk Architecture & Implementation

  • End-to-end Splunk deployments from environment scoping and architecture blueprinting through production cutover
  • Implement, install, and configure Splunk components.
  • Implement federated search and analytics pipelines, enabling data-in-place querying.
  • Build and tune data onboarding pipelines: configure inputs.conf, props.conf, and transforms.conf to normalize multi-vendor log sources at ingestion time into Splunk CIM-compliant data models.
  • Develop and optimize SPL queries, macros, and scheduled searches to power operational detection use cases.

Cisco Data Fabric & Security Stack Integration

  • Implement Splunk data ingestion pipelines from the Cisco security product suite: Cisco Secure Firewall (ASA/FTD), Cisco Secure IDS/IPS, Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cisco Umbrella, and Cisco Thousand Eyes network intelligence telemetry.
  • Configure and validate Cisco Secure Endpoint and Cisco Threat Grid integration with Splunk ES for advanced malware telemetry correlation.
  • Cisco Meraki, Cisco Secure Network Analytics, Cisco XDR.

Operations & Day-to-Day Platform Management

  • Perform platform health and operational stability.
  • Perform capacity planning, index lifecycle management, and Machine Data Lake tiering strategy to control costs without compromising retention SLAs.
  • Execute Splunk version upgrades, patch deployments, and configuration management across all tiers using structured change management processes.

Broader Security Platform Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize next-generation security controls: Cisco Secure Firewall, Palo Alto Networks NGFWs, Fortinet FortiGate, VPN concentrators, Email/Web Security Gateways, and EDR/XDR platforms.
  • Support Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions and Database Activity Monitoring (DAM) platforms such as IBM Guardium as part of a holistic defense-in-depth security architecture.
  • Lead client-facing implementation workshops, present technical architectures and security findings to both engineering and executive stakeholders, and deliver structured knowledge transfer sessions to upskill client security teams.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation: HLD/LLD design artifacts, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and post-implementation reports.

Technical requirements:

Splunk Platform Expertise

  • 5+ years of hands-on Splunk implementation experience in enterprise environments, including distributed multi-site deployments.
  • Proven ability to architect and deploy distributed Splunk infrastructures: Indexer Clusters, Search Head Clusters, Heavy Forwarder pools, Deployment Server hierarchies, and Machine Data Lake tiers.
  • Deep familiarity with Splunk Enterprise Security (ES): correlation searches, threat intelligence management, adaptive response, Risk-Based Alerting (RBA), and risk scoring frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of Cisco Data Fabric architecture: federated search capabilities, data-in-place analytics, and the evolution from full-ingestion to hybrid/federated SIEM pipeline patterns.
  • Familiarity with Splunk AI Toolkit, AI-assisted investigation workflows, and SOAR playbook development using Splunk SOAR is strongly advantageous.

Cisco & Network Security

  • Hands-on experience integrating Cisco security products with Splunk: Secure Firewall (ASA/FTD), Secure IDS/IPS, ISE, Secure Endpoint, Umbrella, ThousandEyes, and Secure Network Analytics.
  • Strong understanding of Cisco security event logging formats (syslog, eStreamer, REST/API telemetry) and their normalization into Splunk CIM data models.
  • Working knowledge of network security fundamentals: firewall policy management, IDS/IPS tuning, and VPN configuration.
  • Experience with additional NGFW platforms including Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet is advantageous.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of technical experience in cybersecurity implementation and professional services delivery.
  • Strong client-facing skills: ability to present complex security architectures to both engineering and executive audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic proficiency is advantageous for client engagements in Oman.

Certifications:

Splunk Cybersecurity Defense Track | Security Operations Focus

  • Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Analyst
  • Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Engineer
  • Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Architect

Splunk Platform Administration Track | Infrastructure / Deployment Focus

  • Splunk Enterprise Certified Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect
  • Splunk SOAR Certified Automation Developer

Cisco Security Certifications

  • Cisco Certified (CCIE Security)
  • Cisco Certified (CCNP Security)

Broader Security Certifications

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC)

raw.description:
QA Engineer — Wearables, Mobile & Cloud

Remote, United States | Austin preferred | $130,000–$155,000 annual base

Own quality from the wrist to the cloud. Join a lean health-technology team building a wearable platform that turns continuous biometric signals into data researchers, health systems, and enterprise partners can trust.

This is a hands-on role with real influence over what ships. You will trace failures across devices, mobile SDKs, APIs, and cloud services; build automation; fix bugs where you can; and lead the push to make every release more reliable.

What You’ll Own

  • Test the full journey: wearable firmware, Bluetooth pairing and sync, iOS and Android SDKs, cloud processing, APIs, and the app.
  • Reproduce difficult failures, find root causes in device and server logs, and deliver fixes or clear engineering handoffs.
  • Build automated SDK, API, and app tests into CI.
  • Own bug triage and release gates, prioritizing customer impact across hardware, mobile, and backend teams.
  • Test the conditions that matter in daily use: overnight wear, workouts, low battery, weak signal, offline use, and OS updates.

What You Bring

  • Substantial QA or test-engineering experience, typically 5+ years, including at least two years owning quality at a startup shipping hardware and software.
  • Hands-on Bluetooth/BLE and mobile-device testing, with clear examples of releases you owned and reliability you improved.
  • Coding in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript; the ability to read and fix Swift, Kotlin, or Go; and experience building automated test suites.
  • Exposure to native mobile and cloud systems. The environment includes Go, Swift, Kotlin, AWS/S3, Firebase Crashlytics, and Mixpanel. You do not need to be an expert in every tool.
  • Practical use of AI coding or testing tools, with a clear approach to checking their output.
  • A sustained, explainable work history with clear personal ownership of shipped work.

Wearables, biometrics, health technology, IoT, firmware testing, and data-pipeline experience are especially relevant. Strong experience with other connected products is welcome.

Why Join

Take ownership across the entire product, shape the quality function, and make a visible difference to a platform people rely on every night. This player-coach role keeps you close to the code, the devices, and the decisions.

Compensation

$130,000–$155,000 annual base, plus equity and benefits. Final terms depend on experience, scope, and location.

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.

Salary: $130,000 – $155,000 / year

raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

This position will serve as the lead statistical programmer for assigned real-world analytics and programming studies, independently managing programming activities from study initiation through final deliverables. The individual will be responsible for translating study protocols, statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and analysis specifications into high-quality, reproducible programming solutions and study outputs.

The Real-World Analytics Programmer will partner closely with HEOR/RWE scientists, data scientists, biostatisticians, and other cross-functional stakeholders to support the successful execution of observational research studies. The role requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple studies and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the lead statistical programmer for assigned real-world studies and manage programming activities from study kickoff through final delivery.

  • Leads programming deliverables from study initiation through final report, including analysis dataset specifications, TLF shells, validation plans, programming documentation, and final study outputs.

  • Reviews and understand study-specific documents including protocols, SAPs, analysis specifications, and study concept documents to ensure accurate implementation of study requirements.

  • Translates study designs and analytic specifications into efficient, scalable, and reproducible programming solutions.

  • Independently develops, validates, and maintains SAS, SQL, R, Python, and other programming solutions for cohort construction, endpoint derivation, analysis dataset creation, and study deliverables.

  • Generates and quality-control analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures (TLFs) in accordance with study protocols, SAPs, analysis specifications, and internal standards.

  • Supports a broad range of HEOR/RWE studies, including treatment pattern analyses, burden of illness studies, comparative effectiveness and safety studies, natural history studies, and external control arm analyses.

  • Implements and validate analytic methods specified in study protocols and SAPs, including survival analyses, propensity score approaches, confounding adjustment methods, and sensitivity analyses.

  • Works with multiple oncology-focused real-world data assets, including claims, electronic health records (EHR), genomic testing databases, and linked clinical-genomic datasets.

  • Assesses data quality, completeness, and fitness-for-purpose and provide recommendations regarding data availability and implementation feasibility.

  • Independently performs quality control and validation activities for programming code, analysis datasets, and study outputs.

  • Develops and maintains technical documentation, programming specifications, reusable code, macros, and reproducible analytic workflows for assigned studies.

  • Collaborates closely with HEOR/RWE scientists, Data Scientists, and Biostatisticians to ensure accurate implementation of study methodologies and successful delivery of study objectives.

  • Communicates programming assumptions, implementation decisions, timelines, and risks to study teams and stakeholders.

  • Contributes to real-world programming standards, quality frameworks, and best practices.

  • Provides technical guidance to junior programmers as appropriate.

  • Stays current with evolving industry best practices, technologies, and regulatory expectations related to oncology real-world data and evidence generation.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • BS/MS degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Epidemiology, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.

  • 8+ years of statistical programming experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, healthcare research, or related settings for Senior-level candidates.

  • Demonstrated experience independently leading programming activities for observational research, HEOR, epidemiology, or real-world evidence studies.

  • Strong SAS or R programming experience required, including experience developing analysis datasets and study deliverables from complex healthcare data sources.

  • Experience with SQL required and working knowledge of R or other programming language for data manipulation, analytics support, and quality control activities preferred.

  • Experience developing analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures (TLFs) from complex healthcare or real-world data sources.

  • Experience working with large healthcare databases, including claims, EHR, genomic, registry, or linked clinical-genomic datasets.

  • Strong understanding of observational research workflows and implementation of study specifications.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting timelines and quality expectations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Thrives in a collaborative team environment and is motivated to drive high-quality technical execution and continuous process improvement.

Preferred Skills:

  • Oncology drug development or oncology real-world evidence experience.

  • Experience working with major oncology or healthcare real-world data assets, such as Flatiron Health, ConcertAI, COTA, Tempus, Guardant, Merative MarketScan, Komodo, Optum, TriNetX, or similar datasets.

  • Experience supporting HTA, market access, indirect treatment comparison (ITC), external control arm, or regulatory-grade real-world evidence studies.

  • Experience developing reusable programming frameworks, standardized macros, and validation tools.

  • Experience with Git, version control systems, and reproducible analytics workflows.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced and growing biotechnology organization.

Job Description Summary

We are seeking strategic, customer-focused Cardiovascular (CV) Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) Market Development Leaders to accelerate growth across the ambulatory surgery center market. Each position will cover the East, Central, or Western U.S. and will identify, shape, and advance high-value ASC opportunities within the assigned region by engaging executive stakeholders, developing account and market strategies, and coordinating the full breadth of GE HealthCare capabilities around customer needs.

The role serves as the commercial orchestrator for complex opportunities, partnering with regional sales teams, product specialists, solution architects, marketing, finance, operations, and external ecosystem partners from early development through sales handoff and close.

Job Description

Responsibilities

· Regional Market and Opportunity Development: Build and execute a development plan for the assigned region. Identify priority markets, accounts, projects, partners, and new opportunities across cardiovascular and broader multi-modality CV ASC needs.

· Strategic Account Development: Develop executive relationships with CV ASC owners, operators, health systems, physician groups, private equity sponsors, management service organizations, developers, consultants, architects, and construction partners.

· Commercial Orchestration: Serve as the central development lead for complex CV ASC opportunities and align account executives, product specialists, solution architects, service, finance, applications, project management, and other stakeholders around one customer strategy.

· Discovery and Solution Shaping: Lead early-stage discovery covering the customer business model, clinical strategy, facility plan, timeline, capital approach, and decision process. Coordinate tailored, scalable solutions reflecting customer needs and GE HealthCare portfolio capabilities.

· Pipeline Creation and Advancement: Create, maintain, and advance a healthy regional pipeline of qualified CV ASC opportunities with clear milestones, stakeholders, risks, competitive position, next steps, and ownership.

· Sales Partnership and Handoff: Partner with regional and account sales leaders throughout the pursuit. Define a clear transition from development to sales execution while preserving strategy, executive alignment, and customer continuity.

· Ecosystem and Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with partners that influence CV ASC planning, development, financing, construction, management, and clinical operations.

· Market Intelligence: Monitor outpatient migration, regulatory and reimbursement developments, competitive activity, ownership changes, and new facility development, converting insights into regional commercial actions.

· Business Management and Governance: Maintain account plans, pursuit strategies, pipeline data, forecasts, and activity metrics. Communicate progress, barriers, resource needs, and market insights through regular operating reviews.

· Growth and Commercial Outcomes: Contribute to assigned operating-plan objectives through qualified pipeline generation, opportunity progression, strategic positioning, and support of CV ASC orders and revenue growth.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 5 years or a minimum of 8 years of selling, business development, market development, consulting, or promotion experience in medical technology, healthcare, a technical field, or life sciences.
  • Proven success developing complex healthcare opportunities and building relationships with executive-level stakeholders.
  • Experience working in or with ambulatory surgery centers, cardiovascular care, healthcare systems, physician groups, medical technology, or related healthcare services.
  • Ability to develop and execute account and regional market strategies in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Strong business acumen connecting customer strategy, clinical needs, facility planning, capital priorities, and commercial solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities, influence without direct authority, and drive cross-functional accountability.
  • Ability to travel within the assigned region, up to 60% and located within one hour of a major airport.

Desired Characteristics

  • Firsthand ASC experience working with an MSO, private equity, or IDN-owned ASC, or current experience serving on an ASC-focused team.
  • Deep knowledge of the ASC market, outpatient migration, and the stakeholders involved in planning, building, financing, equipping, and operating an ASC.
  • Established relationships with ASC operators, MSOs, private equity firms, IDNs, physician groups, developers, consultants, architects, or management organizations.
  • Experience with cardiovascular, imaging, ultrasound, patient monitoring, anesthesia, digital, service, or multi-modality healthcare solutions.
  • Ability to lead structured discovery, build an executive-level value proposition, and translate strategy into a disciplined pursuit plan.
  • Strong analytical, project-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaborative leadership style with success aligning sales, marketing, product, finance, operations, and service teams.
