Job Description

Senior Regulatory Medical Writer (FSP; Remote; US)

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development, and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Summarized Purpose:

We are excited to expand our Medical Writing FSP Team and are seeking candidates based in the US! As a remote-based Senior Medical Writer within the FSP team, you will provide high-quality medical and scientific writing from planning and coordination through delivery of final drafts to internal and external clients. You will collaborate with internal and external clients, supporting and enabling effective and efficient communication that results in operational excellence. The Senior Medical Writer may assist the program manager. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in authoring clinical regulatory documents; ideally they will also bring the versatility to author and support preclinical regulatory documents as part of a broader regulatory writing portfolio.

Essential Functions:

  • Serves as a primary author who writes and provides input on routine clinical documents such as clinical study reports and study protocols and summarizes data from clinical studies.
  • Serve as a primary author who writes complex clinical and scientific and program level documents, such as IBs, bioassay reports, INDs, and MAAs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather necessary information and ensure the accuracy and completeness of documents.
  • Ensure documents align with regulatory guidelines, company standards, and industry best practices.
  • Provide input on document content, structure, and presentation.
  • Review and provide feedback on documents prepared by other team members.
  • Manage timelines and deliverables for assigned projects.
  • Mentor and provide oversight to junior medical writers and ensure high-quality deliverables
  • Stay current with industry trends, guidelines, and regulatory requirements.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification; Advanced degree preferred.
  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years).
  • Experience working in the pharmaceutical/CRO industry preferred.
  • Additional qualifications in medical writing (AMWA; EMWA; RAC) advantageous.
  • In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

raw.description:
Entry-Level Freight Dispatcher — Remote

Turn your communication, organization, and problem-solving skills into a career in U.S. trucking and logistics.

Truck Driver Nation LLC is hiring a full-time Entry-Level Freight Dispatcher to work directly with our team and support our U.S. freight-dispatch operations from a remote, work-from-home environment.

Previous freight-dispatch experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with transferable experience in trucking, transportation, logistics, customer service, sales, operations, scheduling, coordination, or other fast-paced professional environments are encouraged to apply.

Direct freight-dispatch experience is not required for every candidate. Relevant professional experience, transferable skills, transportation knowledge, and the ability to learn quickly will also be considered.

What You'll Do

As an Entry-Level Freight Dispatcher, you will help coordinate freight movement and maintain communication between drivers and the businesses involved in moving each load.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Search and evaluate available freight based on truck location, equipment, mileage, rates, and operational requirements.
  • Communicate professionally with drivers, brokers, carriers, shippers, receivers, and customers.
  • Negotiate freight rates when authorized.
  • Calculate mileage and rate per mile when evaluating potential loads.
  • Plan loads and assist with efficient trip planning.
  • Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments and requirements.
  • Monitor active loads from pickup through delivery.
  • Maintain accurate dispatch records, load notes, and documentation.
  • Provide timely status updates and follow up on active shipments.
  • Assist drivers with routine issues that arise during dispatched loads.
  • Identify delays, scheduling conflicts, or other operational issues and communicate them promptly.
  • Maintain professional working relationships with drivers, brokers, carriers, and customers.

What We're Looking For

  • Freight-dispatch experience is preferred but not required.
  • Relevant experience in trucking, transportation, logistics, customer service, sales, scheduling, operations, administrative coordination, or similar professional environments will be considered.
  • Fluent spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Confidence communicating by phone, email, and web-based business systems.
  • Ability to perform basic mileage and rate-per-mile calculations accurately.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and remain accountable in a remote environment.
  • Computer suitable for daily professional remote work.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.
  • Reliable and professional work-from-home environment.
  • Availability during required U.S. freight-operating hours.
  • Familiarity with U.S. trucking, transportation, or logistics operations is an advantage.

Who May Do Well in This Role

You may be a strong candidate if you naturally think ahead, communicate confidently, pay attention to details, and understand how individual decisions can affect a driver's time, a customer's freight, and the profitability of a truck.

Direct freight-dispatch experience can be valuable, but it is not the only relevant background. Strong communication, customer service, sales, transportation knowledge, scheduling experience, problem-solving ability, and experience coordinating multiple moving parts can transfer well into this position.

Schedule

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time. Schedule adjustments may occasionally be required based on active freight operations, pickup and delivery requirements, or driver needs.

Compensation

$20.00–$25.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

Ready for Your Next Move?

If you have strong communication skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to stay organized in a fast-moving transportation environment, submit your application to Truck Driver Nation LLC for consideration for this Entry-Level Freight Dispatcher position.

Job Title: Product Support Engineer

Job Location: Budapest, Hungary

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are seeking a talented Product Support Engineer to join our Product Support team. You will be part of a young and exciting company that is recognized as the market leader in the SaaS space with our Industry Cloud for Life Sciences.
Our Product Support team is growing quickly in Poland and Hungary. As a member of the team, you will be tasked with supporting our customers, as well as internal stakeholders, such as our Consulting and Sales Engineering teams. You will work closely with Development and QA teams to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues. You will need to learn and adapt quickly, be persistent, and demonstrate “out of the box” thinking.
This is a full-time job with optional on-call responsibilities for weekend coverage. You must be based and be eligible for employment in Hungary, as Veeva does not anticipate providing support for an employment visa/permit process.

What You'll Do

    • Provide global support covering all issues related to the Veeva product suite
    • Learn everything about our software and use that knowledge to ensure client success
    • Support the client administrators across multiple organizations
    • Troubleshoot critical production issues affecting end-users, including system unavailability and data integrity issues
    • Handle inquiries regarding all technical issues and information requests on application capabilities, navigation, installation, or configuration
    • Provide coordinated support for getting new releases and configuration changes into production
    • Gather information for analysis, carry out the necessary research, set up test environments, replicate issues locally, and propose resolutions or workarounds
    • Be a client-facing representative of the Development and Product teams
    • Document new processes and keep existing documentation and tools up to date as the environment changes
    • Interface with engineering, product management, and professional services when necessary
    • Attend daily meetings and provide status updates

Requirements

    • 2+ years of support experience in 2nd- or 3rd-line product support positions
    • The desire to learn new soft and technical skills
    • Experience working closely with Development and Technical Operations
    • Ability to diagnose and use industry-standard tools and techniques to ensure the application performs to client expectations (e.g., FTP, Postman, AWS Tools)
    • Fluent in English, both written and verbal
    • Analytical mindset, a natural problem solver with a hands-on approach

Nice to Have

    • Understanding of Java, SSO, SQL, HTML
    • Knowledge of Zendesk, Jira, and Confluence

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Cafeteria
    • Private medical insurance
    • Life assurance
    • Glasses reimbursement
    • Mobile phone & home internet reimbursement
    • Commuting cost reimbursement
    • Health & wellness programs
    • Free snacks, fruits, and beverages in the office
    • Free in-office lunch every Tuesday and Wednesday

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 9,500,000 - 15,000,000 HUF
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
#RemoteHungary
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. Overview:
The NGG program is seeking a Principal‑level Palo Alto Networks Subject Matter Expert to lead the design, deployment, and optimization of advanced network security architectures. This role provides senior‑level technical leadership across firewall engineering, network segmentation, threat prevention, and Zero Trust integration. The ideal candidate has deep, hands‑on expertise with Palo Alto Networks platforms and can drive enterprise‑scale solutions from strategy through implementation.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead architecture, engineering, and configuration of Palo Alto firewalls across NGG environments
  • Own the design and deployment of security policies, NAT, app‑ID, user‑ID, and threat profiles
  • Architect and optimize Panorama for centralized management, multi‑tenant configurations, and scale
  • Implement Zero Trust segmentation aligned with NGG security requirements
  • Support migration from legacy security stacks to Palo Alto platforms
  • Develop high‑quality design artifacts: HLDs, LLDs, diagrams, runbooks, implementation plans
  • Conduct advanced troubleshooting, packet analysis, and platform tuning
  • Advise program leadership on best practices, risks, and roadmap recommendations

  • 10+ years in network security engineering with 5+ years hands‑on Palo Alto Networks experience
  • Deep expertise in: Panorama, virtual and hardware firewalls, GlobalProtect, Threat Prevention, URL Filtering, WildFire
  • Proven experience architecting large‑scale, mission‑critical firewall infrastructures
  • Strong understanding of routing, VLANs, IPSec VPN, BGP/OSPF, and network segmentation
  • Experience with Zero Trust frameworks and micro‑segmentation strategies
  • Ability to create detailed engineering documentation and lead complex deployments
  • Strong communication skills with ability to brief leadership and stakeholders
  • Secret Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Candidate has hands‑on experience with Palo Alto WildFire, including deployment, configuration, policy integration, and operational troubleshooting in enterprise environments.
  • PCNSE or higher (PCSNE, PSE certifications)
  • Experience with automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, PanOS APIs)
  • Background supporting federal or regulated environments
  • Experience integrating Palo Alto with SIEM, SOAR, and identity platforms

Deliverables:

  • Architecture designs, implementation plans, and technical documentation
  • Configured firewalls, Panorama templates, and policy baselines
  • Migration plans and cutover support
  • Ongoing engineering support, optimization, and troubleshooting

Blue Origin is seeking a Principal ASIC Test Engineer to lead production test strategy for RF, mmWave, and mixed-signal integrated circuits within Silicon Systems.

This individual contributor role serves as the technical lead for final test of mmWave front-end ICs and converter-intensive ASICs, with focus on RF/mmWave performance, high-speed ADC and DAC testing, manufacturability, and cost of test.

The role leads test engagement with manufacturing and OSAT partners and mentors internal test engineers supporting front-end IC and digital beamformer programs.

- Relocation provided

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadLoomwork, an AI automation venture.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadLoomwork, an AI automation venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Loomworkis an AI automation agency for growing companies. Every growing company knows AI is its next growth lever, but few have the people to turn it into working systems. Implementation is the scarce resource.Loomworkhelps them find where AI will pay off, builds agents into the tools they already use, and keeps those agents running. It launches as a services business with a dedicated technical delivery team from day one. Every engagement also serves as research: as client work converges on one segment, Loomwork turns its library of deployed agents into a connected product and grows from agency to software company.

Market Context

The global AI consulting services market is valued at $11.9B in 2026 and is projected to reach $73.9B by 2034, growing at a 25.6% CAGR. North America holds about 38% of the market. Enterprise AI adoption climbed from 20% in 2017 to 88% in 2025, and adoption is outpacing the talent available to deploy it. Roughly 190,000 US and Canadian companies fall in the $10M to $300M revenue range, which puts the serviceable market at an estimated $3B a year. Most of these companies are too large for freelancers and too small for enterprise firms.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across the industry and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the direction of the venture and lead its execution.

  • Strategy: Shape the service offering, pricing, and positioning, and choose the segment to specialize in based on where demand converges

  • Customer Development: Win engagements with growing companies, move clients from assessment to build to retainer, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product: Partner with the FutureSight delivery and engineering team to turn repeated client builds into reusable agents and, ultimately, a connected product

  • Capital: Lead future fundraising, supported by FutureSight's network and the agency's traction

  • Team: Recruit and lead the founding team, including a technical leader as the product takes shape, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to AI implementation, consulting, or selling technology services into growing companies

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Retail Media is a core function to enable this transformation. As the digital landscape continues to evolve, we’re looking for data driven, entrepreneurial-minded, and consumer-obsessed media experts to help us on this journey.

The Sr. Manager, Retail Media Measurement role serves as the central owner of streamlining & enhancing the Kraft Heinz approach to Retail Media Measurement through Technology, Data, Reporting, & Analytics. The position requires a candidate that is a strong influencer, strategic thinker, self-starter, and change maker. The individual is hungry to learn, redefine, and is comfortable with change, ambiguity, and rapid industry growth.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

  • Commercial mix analytics (MMM); quarterly insight generation/advisory, modeling partner, data input management & scaling, management of additional supplemental deep dive analysis
  • Retail media measurement capabilities, analytics & incrementality; partnering with Retail Media Networks & Media Agency to advance capabilities and measurement methodologies, governing internal selection of key KPIs, analyzing returns, etc.
  • Retail media agency reporting & benchmark development; partnering with retail media agency to determine learning agenda, key measurement principles & identifying benchmarks tied to business KPIs
  • Annual learning agenda aligned to business KPIs; running analysis and determining key optimizations/actions for the business, storytelling and sharing with stakeholders (e.g., BUs)

  • Partner with internal teams to connect Retail Media Measurement, Performance, & Insights to broader business (i.e. Data & Analytics, Data Science, Marketing Analytics)

Expected Experience & Required Skills:

  • 7+ years experience utilizing any combination of advanced and predictive analytics, marketing analytics, and analytic techniques for marketing, media, customer and business application
  • 7+ years experience with large datasets to deliver marketing and business strategy; marketing mix modeling experience preferred
  • 5-7 years experience with performance media data (retail media data experience preferred)

Location: Remote role, candidate can be located anywhere in the U.S. Preferred candidate will be located in EST or CST time zones.

Travel: Approximately 10% travel on an annual basis

Reporting to: Director, Sales and Business Development

Role: Full Time


Join our global Sales & Business Development organization in a dedicated outbound role, creating qualified enterprise pipeline within an agreed territory and set of target accounts.

You will combine account research, consistent prospecting and consultative discovery to engage senior stakeholders, uncover meaningful business challenges and develop opportunities with clear commercial potential. Success requires both relevant, high-quality engagement and sustained outbound activity.

Working closely with Enterprise Account Managers and regional sales leadership, you will own prospecting, initial discovery and qualification to an agreed handover. Account Managers retain ownership of the wider account relationship and subsequent sales cycle.

The Role

Plan and execute enterprise outreach

  • Agree target accounts and priorities with Account Managers and regional sales leadership, aligning outreach with account ownership, existing relationships and territory plans.
  • Research account fit, industry priorities, organizational changes and business triggers to build focused prospecting plans.
  • Map relevant decision-makers and influencers, developing account-specific messaging that connects their priorities to the business problems Enablon helps address.
  • Execute consistent outbound prospecting across phone, email and social channels, meeting agreed activity standards and following up with discipline.

Discover, qualify and hand over opportunities

  • Lead structured discovery to understand the business problem, its impact, relevant scope and the prospect’s willingness to explore a solution.
  • Test whether there is a credible opportunity, document qualification evidence and agree a meaningful next step with the prospect.
  • Engage Account Managers and, where needed, Pre-Sales at the appropriate point to support commercial or technical discovery.
  • Deliver a coordinated handover with documented business challenges, stakeholders, scope and agreed next steps; confirm Account Manager acceptance and preserve customer continuity.
  • Achieve agreed Qualified Sales Opportunity (QSO) and qualified pipeline targets, taking accountability for the quality of the opportunities you create.

Operate with commercial discipline

  • Record outbound activity, discovery findings and next steps accurately and promptly in Salesforce against the relevant leads, contacts, accounts and opportunities.
  • Use activity, engagement and conversion data to improve targeting, messaging and execution.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing and Product Marketing on account insight and outbound campaigns, sharing customer feedback and market intelligence.
  • Participate actively in training, coaching and team collaboration, applying feedback to improve performance.

What you will bring

Essential

  • 5+ years experience in B2B sales or business development, with demonstrable success in outbound prospecting and generating qualified new business opportunities.
  • The ability to research complex organizations, prioritize accounts and translate insight into relevant outreach.
  • Confidence engaging senior business stakeholders, supported by strong written communication, active listening and thoughtful questioning.
  • Experience conducting discovery conversations and assessing whether a business need merits further sales engagement.
  • Strong organization, consistent follow-through and experience maintaining accurate records in Salesforce or another CRM. Experience using Sales Engagement and AI tooling to enhance your outbound prospection velocity and techniques.
  • Commercial curiosity, resilience, personal accountability and a willingness to learn through coaching and feedback.

Desirable

  • Experience prospecting into enterprise or strategic accounts and navigating multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Exposure to SaaS or enterprise technology, particularly EHS, ESG, sustainability, risk or compliance solutions.
  • Experience collaborating with Account Managers, Account Executives or Pre-Sales teams.
  • Familiarity with consultative selling and qualification methodologies such as MEDDIC, MEDDPICC or Sandler.
  • Proficient in multiple languages
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

How we measure Success

Your primary outcomes are achievement of agreed QSO/qualified pipeline creation targets. A QSO must meet our qualification standards, with evidence of a relevant business problem, defined scope and willingness to progress, supported by an agreed next step and Account Manager acceptance.

Supporting indicators include target-account coverage, sustained outbound activity, meaningful engagement, discovery-to-opportunity conversion, handover quality and Salesforce accuracy. We also review subsequent pipeline progression with Account Managers to assess and improve qualification quality; Account Managers own the opportunity after handover.

Why join us?

You will help open conversations with organizations facing significant operational, regulatory and sustainability challenges. You will join a global team that values customer impact, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning and diverse perspectives, with the opportunity to build expertise in commercially meaningful enterprise business development.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

$57,400.00 - $98,350.00 USD

Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. raw.excerpt: The OpportunityEvery used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart

  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed

  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate

  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you

  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up

  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need

  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors

  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something

  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app

  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning

  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"

  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on

  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself

  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead

  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data

  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)

  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there

  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

This role is right for you if you’re constantly monitoring the latest trends in social media and emerging platforms, including in the creator industry, and love to experiment and innovate.   As a key strategic leader on the new USA TODAY audience team, you will combine expertise in social and vertical video production, data analytics, and platform insights to grow audience and discoverability, deepen engagement, and support new revenue opportunities. You will lead audience-focused experimentation for our off-platform video distribution, testing new approaches and engagement strategies that drive measurable growth. We’re looking for someone who can anticipate and respond to shifts in social media and video trends and audience behavior, continually refining strategy while ensuring the consistency of our brand voice and identity across our portfolio of accounts. In this role, you will also help strengthen audience engagement across the newsroom by coaching journalists on effective social video practices. The successful candidate will be a collaborative, strategic thinker who can work across divisions and translate company-wide priorities into clear, actionable plans for the newsroom. In addition, you actively partner with our Video Production Team, helping plan for major tentpole events, host trainings for our journalists and set our broader off-platform video strategies.

Help us ensure the future of journalism is strong and that our newsroom continues to evolve to meet the needs of a growing digital audience. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.

Responsibilities:

Lead USA TODAY’s social video strategy (including our strategy for user-generated content), working with USA TODAY leaders and the broader USA TODAY audience team to assess our portfolio and performance and drive innovation. Establish a cohesive editorial style for USA TODAY’s social video journalism, ensuring content is tailored to platform behaviors and audience needs. Monitor the creator industry, emerging platforms, and evolving audience behaviors, translating insights into targeted experiments and practical newsroom guidance. Develop strategies that encompass the entire audience journey, thinking about every action we want a user to take with us. Analyze performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead experiments in partnership with content strategy. Adapt platform strategy in real time to deliver timely, relevant experiences during breaking news and major events, pitching in on content creation where necessary. Translate data points into actionable insights. The right candidate deeply understands data tools and knows how to apply their analytical mindset to content. Partner across divisions to improve social video revenue and consumer retention. Lead the audience team’s relationship with our video production team, working together to plan coverage and develop strategies for major tentpoles, events and story opportunities. Collaborate with AI leads to test and implement tools that improve social video production and workflow efficiency. Coach journalists on social video storytelling, production techniques, and technical tools, and lead training for reporters, visual journalists, content creators and editors. Balance and execute editorial and business priorities while keeping audience needs and broader organizational goals at the center of every decision.

Requirements: 

Bachelor's or master's degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience. 5+ years of experience in digital journalism or newsroom leadership, including experience in a digital, print, or television news organization. Journalism experience is mandatory.

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Digital Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design and verification of digital and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet solutions, including PCS (Physical Coding Sublayer) logic and custom high-speed interfaces such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe. Working alongside experienced digital and analog engineers, you will write RTL, build testbenches and behavioural models, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in digital design who want to learn fast through hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • RTL Design: Design and implement digital blocks for PCS and interface IP (e.g. encoders/decoders, scramblers, PRBS generators/checkers, FIFOs, CDC logic, control and calibration state machines) in Verilog/SystemVerilog, under the guidance of senior designers.
  • Standards & Specifications: Study SerDes and UCIe standards and architecture documents, and help turn them into clear block-level specifications.
  • Verification: Build testbenches and run simulations to verify your designs, using SystemVerilog, UVM or cocotb, and help develop verification plans and coverage.
  • Mixed-Signal Modelling: Write behavioural models of analog blocks in Verilog/SystemVerilog (and Verilog-A where needed) to support mixed-signal and top-level simulation with the analog team.
  • Implementation Support: Gain exposure to synthesis, lint, CDC checks and static timing analysis, and learn how design choices affect power, performance and area.
  • Scripting & Automation: Use scripting (e.g. Python, TCL or shell) to automate simulation, regression and reporting flows.
  • Documentation & Process: Document your designs and test results clearly, and contribute ideas to improve our design and verification environments and procedures.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with an experienced team of digital, analog and layout engineers across products such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)
  • 0–2 years of experience in digital design, including internships, placements or university projects
  • Solid understanding of digital logic fundamentals: synchronous design, finite state machines, timing, pipelining and clock-domain crossing
  • Hands-on experience writing RTL in Verilog or SystemVerilog, through coursework, thesis, FPGA or internship projects
  • Experience with an HDL simulator (e.g. Xcelium, VCS, Questa or open-source tools such as Verilator or Icarus)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.
Nice-to-have:
  • Exposure to verification methodologies such as UVM, SystemVerilog assertions or cocotb
  • Basic knowledge of synthesis, static timing analysis or place-and-route
  • Familiarity with high-speed serial interfaces or protocols (e.g. UCIe, Ethernet, PCIe) or line coding (e.g. 8b/10b, 64b/66b)
  • Awareness of Design-for-Test concepts (scan, BIST) and hardware/software co-design
  • Scripting skills in Python, TCL or shell, and comfort in a Linux environment
  • FPGA prototyping experience

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain your work concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from design reviews
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star: We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely: We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact: Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn't disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work: We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we'll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real digital and mixed-signal IP used in customer silicon, from your first months
  • Mentorship from day one – a dedicated manager and experienced engineers who will review your work and help you grow
  • Competitive, transparent compensation – adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – structured onboarding, AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview (90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min) – values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps – we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.

Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

gestalte mit uns die energiewende

Wir von TESVOLT Energy machen es für Betreiber kleiner und mittlerer Batteriespeicher erstmals möglich, lukrativ am Flexibilitätshandel teilzunehmen. Bisher hatten sie keine Chance, einen guten Trader zu finden, der ihre kleineren Speicherkapazitäten an der Energiebörse handelt. Wir bringen sie gebündelt als virtuelles Kraftwerk ans Netz – gehandelt durch die besten Trader am Markt.

Unsere Arbeit ist technisch anspruchsvoll, datenbasiert und nah an der Praxis. Genau das begeistert unser Team: ein Umfeld, in dem Analyst:innen, Entwickler:innen und Strateg:innen gemeinsam etwas bewegen können.

Du denkst Infrastruktur nicht nur mit, sondern voraus? Du willst Systeme bauen, die stabil, sicher und skalierbar sind – und gleichzeitig Entwicklerteams empowern? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Diese Stelle kannst du remote bei uns ausführen.

deine aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Marketing bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachbereitung von Kampagnen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Du erstellst und pflegst Content für unsere Website, LinkedIn und weitere Kommunikationskanäle und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Themen verständlich, professionell und zielgruppengerecht aufbereitet werden.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Broschüren, Grafiken und weiteren Marketingmaterialien und achtest dabei auf eine saubere Umsetzung unseres Corporate Designs.
  • Du wirkst bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Messen, Veranstaltungen und vertriebsnahen Kommunikationsformaten mit.
  • Du wertest Marketing Kennzahlen aus, bereitest Ergebnisse übersichtlich auf und hilfst dabei, unsere Aktivitäten datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei der Erstellung von Erlösberechnungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen für Batteriespeicherprojekte.
  • Du bereitest Kundendaten, Projektinformationen sowie Angebots- und Präsentationsunterlagen strukturiert für Vertrieb, Partner und Management auf.
  • Du pflegst CRM und Kundendaten zuverlässig und stellst sicher, dass relevante Informationen sauber dokumentiert und für das Team nutzbar sind.
  • Du bekommst einen umfassenden Einblick in Marketing und Sales eines innovativen Unternehmens der Energiewirtschaft, von Website Texten und LinkedIn Beiträgen über Kampagnen bis hin zu konkreten Vertriebsprojekten.

dein profil

  • Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft, Energiewirtschaft oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du interessierst dich für erneuerbare Energien, Batteriespeicher, Energiehandel und die Frage, wie wirtschaftlich tragfähige Lösungen die Energiewende voranbringen können.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Themen sauber aufzubereiten und sichtbar voranzubringen.
  • Du verfügst zwingend über gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1/B2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Inhalte klar, präzise und adressatengerecht formulieren.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel.
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Marketing-Content, Präsentationen oder Social Media Beiträgen sind von Vorteil.
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, visuelle Kommunikation und saubere Unterlagen ist wünschenswert.
  • Du hast Lust auf die hands-on Mentalität eines jungen Start-ups und schätzt gleichzeitig die Zugehörigkeit zu einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe

warum wir?

Wir sind ein Team aus Batteriespeicher-, Daten- und Energiemarktexpert:innen, die vorher teils bei
TESVOLT und teils in der Energie-Praxis bei anderen Scale-Ups, einschlägigen Beratungen und
Energieversorgern gearbeitet haben und bringen Know-how zu Batteriespeichern und

Energiehandel aus erster Hand mit.

Uns verbindet die Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich tragfähiger Klimaschutz möglich ist – mit
klugen Ideen, starken Partnern und einem besonderen Team.

  • Du erhältst Einblicke in die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft, des Energiehandels und der Flexibilitätsvermarktung von Batteriespeichern.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, nah an echten Projekten und mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Management zusammen und bekommst dadurch einen breiten Blick auf ein wachsendes Geschäftsmodell.
  • Dich erwartet ein motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher fachlicher Nähe und der gemeinsamen Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Klimaschutz möglich ist.

raw.description:
Associate Managing Editor

Job Purpose

The Associate Managing Editor is responsible for the end-to-end management and development of assigned journals, ensuring timely publication, operational excellence, and strong stakeholder engagement. The role works closely with editors, authors, reviewers, societies, and internal teams to support journal growth, publication quality, indexing objectives, and overall portfolio performance.

Key Responsibilities

Journal & Portfolio Management

  • Manage the end-to-end publication process for assigned journals, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of issues.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for journal-related operational matters and escalations.

  • Coordinate closely with editors, editorial boards, authors, reviewers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient journal operations.

  • Ensure a seamless transition of newly acquired journals from the acquisitions stage to editorial management.

  • Monitor publishing schedules and proactively address delays to maintain publication timelines.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with journal editors, authors, reviewers, society partners, and internal teams.

  • Liaise regularly with Sage India, UK, and US colleagues to address editorial, production, and operational requirements.

  • Provide high-quality service and support to editors, societies, and contributors.

Journal Development & Performance

  • Identify opportunities to enhance journal performance, visibility, and impact.

  • Work closely with editors on manuscript flow, turnaround times, editorial planning, and publication strategies.

  • Drive initiatives related to journal indexing, abstracting, Impact Factor acquisition, and overall portfolio growth.

  • Educate and guide editors on indexing criteria, citation performance, and Impact Factor improvement strategies.

  • Identify and implement journal-specific development plans to improve performance and reach.

Marketing & Promotion

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop and execute journal-specific promotional activities, including:

    • Call for Papers campaigns

    • Impact Factor announcements

    • Special Issue promotions

    • Article-level marketing initiatives

    • Conference and event promotional support

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and present journal performance reports and publisher reports for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

  • Maintain accurate journal records, reports, and portfolio documentation.

  • Prepare personal performance reports aligned with departmental objectives.

Contract & Business Management

  • Support drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing journal contract renewals and addenda.

  • Develop an understanding of publishing business models and contractual frameworks.

  • Support onboarding, maintenance, and renewal of new publishing products and content solutions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated on industry developments, publishing trends, and emerging technologies.

  • Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.

  • Work independently to achieve departmental objectives while escalating issues appropriately when required.

Key Accountabilities

  • Effective management of assigned journal portfolios.

  • Delivery of publication schedules and service-level commitments.

  • Enhanced journal visibility through indexing and abstracting achievements.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction and relationship management.

  • Accurate reporting and performance tracking.

  • Successful implementation of journal development initiatives.

  • Compliance with publishing standards, contracts, and internal policies.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, Publishing, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 2-3 years of experience in scholarly journal publishing within an editorial or journal management environment.

  • Experience managing journals throughout the publication lifecycle.

  • Hands-on experience with journal development activities, indexing applications, and editorial workflows.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Scholarly publishing processes

    • Peer review management

    • Journal management and development

    • Publishing contracts and business models

    • Abstracting and Indexing (A&I) databases

    • Impact Factor and journal performance metrics

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly:

    • Excel

    • PowerPoint

    • Outlook

    • Teams

    • SharePoint

  • Experience with peer review management systems is preferred.

Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced publishing environment.

Success Measures

  • Timely publication of assigned journals.

  • Improved journal performance and indexing outcomes.

  • High editor, author, reviewer, and society satisfaction.

  • Achievement of departmental and individual KPIs.

  • Effective management of journal portfolios and stakeholder relationships.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

  • Deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten sind ausgeprägt, und du kannst in verschiedenen Kontexten klar und effizient kommunizieren.

Ingeniero/a Senior de Proyectos Eléctricos

En Grupo Clave estamos colaborando con una compañía de referencia en el sector de la ingeniería y la energía en la búsqueda de un/a Ingeniero/a Senior de Proyectos Eléctricos para incorporarse a su equipo técnico.

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia consolidada en el desarrollo y gestión de proyectos eléctricos, capaz de liderar proyectos de forma autónoma y aportar visión técnica en el ámbito de las infraestructuras energéticas.

Modalidad de trabajo: Teletrabajo

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Liderar y desarrollar proyectos relacionados con infraestructuras eléctricas, participando en todas las fases del proyecto, desde la ingeniería y tramitación hasta el acompañamiento durante la ejecución.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Redacción y supervisión de proyectos de líneas de Alta, Media y Baja Tensión.

  • Diseño y desarrollo de Centros de Transformación y Subestaciones Eléctricas.

  • Elaboración de ingeniería básica y de detalle.

  • Coordinación técnica con clientes, organismos, suministradoras y equipos de obra.

  • Gestión de presupuestos, documentación técnica y planificación de proyectos.

  • Tramitación administrativa y seguimiento técnico hasta su puesta en marcha.

  • Soporte técnico y acompañamiento a perfiles junior.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Titulación en Ingeniería Eléctrica, Ingeniería Industrial (especialidad Electricidad) o formación equivalente.

  • Experiencia sólida en proyectos eléctricos, energéticos o de distribución.

  • Conocimiento de normativa eléctrica y tramitación de proyectos.

  • Experiencia en líneas eléctricas, centros de transformación, subestaciones o instalaciones industriales.

  • Manejo de AutoCAD y herramientas técnicas de diseño y cálculo.

  • Capacidad para gestionar proyectos de forma autónoma y coordinar diferentes interlocutores.

  • Disponibilidad para realizar desplazamientos puntuales cuando el proyecto lo requiera.

Valoraremos especialmente

  • Experiencia en compañías de ingeniería, distribución eléctrica o energías renovables.

  • Conocimientos de automatización, protección y control.

  • Experiencia en gestión de equipos o liderazgo técnico de proyectos.

  • Si bien se ofrece teletrabajo, será valorable la predisposición a ir a oficina.

  • Aunque la posición se desarrolla en modalidad de teletrabajo, valoraremos positivamente la predisposición a acudir de manera ocasional a la oficina de Lugo para reuniones de coordinación o seguimiento de proyectos.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Incorporación a una empresa sólida y en crecimiento.

  • Participación en proyectos estratégicos del sector energético.

  • Flexibilidad horaria y modalidad de teletrabajo.

  • Alto grado de autonomía y responsabilidad.

  • Formación continua y desarrollo profesional.

  • Estabilidad laboral.

  • Banda salarial entre 25.000 € y 35.000 € brutos anuales, en función de la experiencia y aportación al puesto.

Ubicación: España | Teletrabajo

Si cuentas con experiencia en proyectos eléctricos y buscas un entorno que te permita asumir nuevos retos profesionales, desarrollar tu carrera y participar en proyectos de alto impacto, queremos conocerte.

Inscríbete o comparte esta oportunidad con profesionales que puedan encajar en el proyecto.

We’re seeking an accomplished and results-driven Senior Enterprise Sales Executive to join our high-performing sales organization and drive growth in the GCC market. This role requires a consultative sales approach, exceptional relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate multi-stakeholder sales processes within large organizations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive full-cycle enterprise sales — from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and contract execution — targeting senior executives across large organizations.

  • Engage and convert qualified leads provided by the SDR team, while also proactively identifying and developing new opportunities in the enterprise segment.

  • Conduct strategic discovery sessions to understand organizational challenges, business objectives, and long-term goals to craft value-driven solutions.

  • Deliver high-impact presentations and executive-level pitches that clearly articulate ROI and align with client priorities.

  • Manage and influence complex sales cycles involving multiple departments, business units, and decision-makers.

  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of enterprise opportunities, ensuring consistent forecasting accuracy and timely follow-ups.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure a seamless transition from sale to onboarding.

  • Meet and exceed annual revenue targets through disciplined execution, relationship management, and strategic account growth.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years focused on enterprise-level clients in SaaS, technology, or a related industry.

  • Demonstrated success closing six- and seven-figure enterprise deals with VP- and C-suite-level stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to manage long and complex sales cycles (6–12 months) and win competitive deals through strategic consultative selling.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills — able to command a room and deliver persuasive pitches to audiences of 10–15+ executives.

  • Strong hunter mentality with a consistent record of exceeding quotas and driving new business growth.

  • Skilled in solution-based selling and articulating clear business value to enterprise clients.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and modern sales tools.

  • Strong organizational and pipeline management capabilities.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA is a plus.

Who You Are:

You are a strategic, disciplined, and persuasive sales leader who thrives on closing transformational enterprise deals. You think beyond short-term transactions and focus on long-term partnerships. You understand how to navigate corporate hierarchies, influence complex decision-making processes, and translate product value into measurable business outcomes

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE trägst du umfassende Verantwortung für Strukturen, Systeme und Teams.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann.

Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten.

Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen.

Was wir dir bieten

raw.title: Freelance Corporate Facilitator — Leadership & Management
raw.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
raw.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers with a go-to-market approach guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society. You’ll manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.   • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers, building trust and credibility.

Preferred Qualifications

raw.title: Consultant – Feasibility Studies & Technical Due Diligence (Solar, Wind & BESS)
raw.excerpt: 👉 About the jobAt Enertis Applus+, we are looking for a Renewable Energy Consultant to join our Consulting team in Poland.
raw.description:
👉 About the job

At Enertis Applus+, we are looking for a Renewable Energy Consultant to join our Consulting team in Poland. In this role, you will support the technical assessment of renewable energy projects across Poland and Eastern Europe, delivering feasibility studies and technical due diligence for solar PV, wind and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). You will work closely with developers, investors and financial institutions, providing technical expertise throughout the project development and investment process.

🛠️ What will you do?

Your main responsibilities will include: Conduct feasibility studies and technical due diligence for renewable energy projects. Assess project sites, identifying technical, environmental and permitting constraints. Review permits, licenses, authorizations and regulatory documentation. Evaluate grid connection agreements and coordinate technical discussions with TSOs and DSOs. Review engineering documentation at conceptual, basic and detailed design stages. Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation measures. Prepare high-quality technical reports and client deliverables in English. Support commercial proposals, tenders and client presentations. Contribute to business development activities across the Polish and Eastern European markets.

🎯 What are we looking for?

We are looking for talent, not perfection. If you believe you can contribute to the team, even if your profile does not fit 100%, we want to hear from you.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another STEM discipline. 5+ years of experience in renewable energy development, engineering or consultancy. Experience with Solar PV, Wind and/or BESS projects. Strong knowledge of the Polish renewable energy market, permitting processes, grid connection and applicable regulations. Experience preparing technical due diligence or feasibility studies. Strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and client management abilities. Fluent Polish and good command of English. Spanish is considered a plus.

🌍 What do we offer?

Opportunity to work on renewable energy projects across Poland and Eastern Europe. The opportunity to join a consolidated technical team that is a benchmark in the sector. Professional growth opportunities with a well-defined career plan. Be part of a company in constant expansion. Flexible work arrangement with remote working from Poland. Full-time or part-time collaboration under an Employment Contract or B2B agreement. International and multidisciplinary working environment.

🤝 Diversidad e inclusión

En Barlovento Applus+, promovemos un entorno de trabajo diverso, equitativo e inclusivo. Valoramos a todas las personas independientemente de su género, edad, origen, orientación sexual, capacidades o creencias. Apostamos por el talento sin etiquetas.

raw.title: Post-Merger Integration Manager
raw.excerpt: Yopeso has been developing a diverse range of software products, from large-scale applications to smaller solutions, for 20 years.
raw.description:
Yopeso has been developing a diverse range of software products, from large-scale applications to smaller solutions, for 20 years. With a growing team of over 300 employees across five locations, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of growth, transparency, and professionalism.

At Yopeso, we value authenticity, curiosity, and ambition. These values drive us to build strong connections within our community and with our partners, ensuring trust, integrity, and transparency in all our business practices. We strive to maintain the highest professional standards and continuously challenge ourselves to develop high-quality, high-performance, and secure software solutions.

Our approach is rooted in efficient collaboration among passionate professionals working in agile teams. Guided by curiosity and ambition, we strive to create products that are meaningful and impactful, while remaining true to our authentic selves.

Requirements

We are looking for a Post-Merger Integration Manager to lead the successful integration of acquired companies and build a repeatable PMI capability for future acquisitions.

You will own the integration program from pre-close planning and Day 1 readiness through operational and cultural integration, coordinating leaders across the acquiring and acquired organizations. Your focus will be on aligning people, processes, operations, culture, and ways of working to ensure the acquisition delivers its intended business value.

This is a business and organizational integration role, rather than a hands-on technical systems role. Functional leaders across IT, Finance, People/HR, and other areas remain accountable for their respective workstreams, while you own the overall integration plan, governance, coordination, risks, and dependencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end integration planning and execution, from pre-close and Day 1 through stabilization and full integration.

  • Develop and manage the integration roadmap, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success metrics across functional workstreams.

  • Act as the key integration point between senior leadership, functional teams, and the acquired organization.

  • Coordinate People/HR, Finance, IT, Operations, and other workstreams to ensure alignment and effective execution.

  • Identify and resolve organizational, cultural, communication, and process gaps across teams and geographies.

  • Track integration risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions, bringing leadership clear recommendations and solutions.

  • Support the realization of expected synergies, efficiencies, and other deal value.

  • Facilitate integration meetings, workshops, and leadership updates to maintain alignment and accountability.

  • Support due diligence and pre-close planning for future acquisitions, bringing an integration perspective to deal evaluation.

  • Build and continuously improve PMI playbooks, templates, governance processes, and lessons learned to make future integrations faster and more effective.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in post-merger integration, M&A, business transformation, or large-scale organizational change.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional projects across multiple teams, countries, or locations.

  • Strong understanding of organizational, operational, cultural, and people-related aspects of integration.

  • Experience working with senior leadership and managing stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Genuine cross-cultural fluency and experience working with international teams.

  • Strong program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and adapting as priorities change.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with fluent written and spoken English.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to support integration activities.

  • Experience in technology, software, or professional services.
